model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos (primary antibody), Alexa Fluor 647 (secondary antibody), DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly effective for clearing large, fixed adult mouse brains, achieving excellent transparency and preserving tissue architecture. Its organic solvent-based delipidation is robust for whole organs. The method is compatible with immunolabeling of endogenous proteins like c-Fos, a canonical immediate early gene marker for neuronal activation. Using a far-red Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody minimizes autofluorescence, and DAPI provides a nuclear counterstain for cell segmentation and registration to brain atlases. The protocol is well-established for whole-brain mapping projects.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2  Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody (rabbit anti-c-Fos, 1:500 dilution in blocking solution) (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBS-T) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 5 times over 24 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500 dilution in blocking solution) (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBS-T (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 5 times over 24 hours)
2.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Wash with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)

3  Delipidation and Clearing
3.1 Dehydration with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Dehydration with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Dehydration with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Dehydration with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Dehydration with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)
3.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat once)

4  Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, or until tissue is fully transparent)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-NeuN, Alexa Fluor 555-conjugated anti-beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1), Lectin (IB4)-Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency and significant tissue shrinkage (to ~65% of original size), which is advantageous for imaging large samples like whole adult mouse brains. It preserves fluorescence of common dyes (Alexa Fluor series) and endogenous fluorescence well, and its organic-solvent-based approach efficiently removes lipids for deep imaging of neuronal structures. The chosen labeling strategy covers all target structures: DAPI for nuclei/cell bodies, anti-NeuN for mature neurons, anti-TUJ1 for axons and dendrites (neurites), and IB4-lectin for vasculature (which often outlines major fiber tracts and provides anatomical context). This combination allows simultaneous mapping of neuronal soma distribution, axonal/dendritic morphology, and vascular landmarks.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2  Immunostaining and Labeling (performed after step 1.4, before step 1.5)  
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, each for 1 hour at RT.  
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-T) 3 times, 1 hour each at RT.  
2.3 Blocking with PBS-T containing 10% normal donkey serum and 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-NeuN (1:500), chicken anti-beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:1000), IB4-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)  
2.5 Wash with PBS-T 6 times, 1 hour each at RT.  
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  
2.7 Wash with PBS-T 6 times, 1 hour each at RT.  
2.8 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.9 Wash with PBS 3 times, 1 hour each at RT.  
2.10 Dehydration through graded methanol series: 30%, 50%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS, each for 1 hour at RT, then 100% methanol overnight at 4 ℃.  

3  Final Clearing and Refractive Index Matching  
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM in methanol (as in step 1.5).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, repeat once until fully transparent)  

4  Storage and Imaging  
4.1 Store cleared brain in fresh DBE in a light-tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging.  
4.2 For imaging, mount sample in DBE within an appropriate imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos+Alexa Fluor 488, Npas4+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent transparency of whole adult mouse brains, strong preservation of endogenous and antibody-derived fluorescence, and compatibility with organic-solvent-based refractive index matching (DBE, RI=1.56) suitable for high-resolution light-sheet imaging. The method is relatively fast (~1 week) and robust for large samples. The chosen labeling strategy uses primary antibodies against c-Fos (to mark all activated neurons) and Npas4 (to distinguish a specific immediate early gene (IEG) expression profile), combined with DAPI for nuclear counterstaining, enabling dual-color IEG subpopulation mapping at single-cell resolution throughout the cleared brain.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  **Sample Preparation and Fixation**
1.1 Perfusion fixation with 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 20 minutes)
1.2 Post-fixation of dissected whole brain in 4% PFA. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Washing with 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4, 3 times. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour per wash)

2  **Immunolabeling (Pre-clearing)**
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking in PBSMT (0.1 M PBS, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum). (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
2.2 Primary antibody incubation: Incubation with a cocktail of rabbit anti-c-Fos (1:500) and goat anti-Npas4 (1:300) in PBSMT. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.3 Washing with PBST (0.1 M PBS, 0.3% Triton X-100), 6 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
2.4 Secondary antibody incubation: Incubation with a cocktail of donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PBSMT. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Washing with PBST, 6 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
2.6 Nuclear counterstaining: Incubation with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Final wash with 0.1 M PBS, 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

3  **Dehydration and Delipidation**
3.1 Gradual dehydration in a series of tert-butanol (tB) solutions: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 96%, 100% (vol/vol in H2O), each step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)
3.2 Delipidation and dehydration in 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, 2 times)

4  **Refractive Index Matching and Clearing**
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG, RI=1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, 2 times)

5  **Storage and Imaging**
5.1 Store cleared brain in fresh 100% DBE in a light-tight container. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)
5.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber for light-sheet microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos+Alexa Fluor 488, Npas4+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is highly effective for large, fixed adult mouse brains (up to ~1 cm³), achieving excellent transparency and uniform refractive-index matching throughout deep tissue. It preserves endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP/YFP) and antibody-derived signals (Alexa Fluor dyes) well through its tetrahydrofuran (THF)- and dibenzyl ether (DBE)-based dehydration/delipidation. The protocol is faster than simplified CUBIC (days vs. weeks) and avoids the uneven clearing you experienced. Alexa Fluor dyes are compatible with uDISCO’s solvent steps, and DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for cell segmentation. This combination allows robust dual-color detection of immediate-early gene (IEG) products (c-Fos and Npas4) at single-cell resolution across the whole brain.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  

2 Immunostaining (Optional – if primary antibodies require aqueous conditions, perform before Step 1; if using direct fluorophore conjugates or endogenous fluorescence, proceed to Step 3)  
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% normal donkey serum, and 0.02% sodium azide.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Primary antibody incubation: Incubation with anti-c-Fos (rabbit, 1:500) and anti-Npas4 (guinea pig, 1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
2.3 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (3 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  
2.4 Secondary antibody incubation: Incubation with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-guinea pig Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
2.5 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (3 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  
2.6 Nuclear counterstain: Incubation with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.7 Final wash: Incubation with PBS (2 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  

3 Refractive Index Matching and Storage  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.3 Storage and imaging: Transfer cleared brain to fresh DBE in an imaging-compatible chamber.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

The dual-labeling strategy targets β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) to visualize all axons (regenerating and preserved) and GFAP to demarcate glial scars and injury boundaries, enabling clear discrimination of axonal paths relative to the lesion core. 1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

2  Delipidation and Bleaching (optional, if autofluorescence is high)
2.1 Incubation with fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3  Rehydration and Blocking
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)
3.5 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBST) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4.2 Wash with PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 6 times)
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)
4.4 Wash with PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 6 times)
4.5 Optional nuclear staining: Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.6 Wash with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)

5  Final Dehydration
5.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)

6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat once)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Neurofilament-H (NF-H)+Alexa Fluor 647, Hoechst]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing depth and high transparency in dense neural tissue (rat spinal cord, ~15 mm length, ~4 mm diameter), strong fluorescence preservation for Alexa Fluor dyes, and compatibility with whole-mount immunolabeling. The method uses tert-butanol and diphenyl ether for rapid dehydration and delipidation, yielding a refractive index (~1.56) suitable for high-resolution light-sheet imaging. The dual-target strategy labels regenerating/remodeling axons (β-III Tubulin, early marker) and mature/residual axons (Neurofilament-H, structural marker), while Hoechst stains nuclei for spatial reference. This allows simultaneous 3D mapping of axonal regeneration trends and survival/continuity changes.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane and 33% (vol/vol) methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2  Immunolabeling (Whole-Mount)  
2.1 Permeabilization with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Blocking with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, and 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum in PBS for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-β-III Tubulin (1:500) and chicken anti-Neurofilament-H (1:500) in blocking solution for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
2.4 Washing with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS, 6 changes over 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
2.6 Washing with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS, 6 changes over 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
2.7 Nuclear staining with 1 µg/mL Hoechst 33342 in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in H₂O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in H₂O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in H₂O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol for 1 hour, repeated twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
3.6 Incubation with pure diphenyl ether (RI ~1.56) for refractive index matching, until tissue is fully transparent (typically 12–24 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

4  Storage and Imaging  
4.1 Store cleared sample in fresh diphenyl ether in a light-tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: long-term)  
4.2 Mount sample in diphenyl ether-compatible chamber for light-sheet microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 647, GFAP+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS (Polyethylene glycol‑Associated Solvent System) is selected because it provides exceptional tissue integrity preservation, which is critical for preventing fragmentation of the fragile spinal cord injury segment during clearing. It achieves high transparency and refractive index matching without harsh electrophoretic steps. The method is compatible with antibody labeling and small-molecule dyes, and it maintains fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes well. The chosen labeling strategy targets axons (β-III Tubulin), astrocytes/reactive gliosis (GFAP), and nuclei (DAPI), enabling clear visualization of neural fiber architecture, glial boundaries, and cellular context for long-distance tracing across the injury core and proximal/distal regions.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  **Delipidation and Decolorization**
    1.1 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) N‑Bromoacetamide (NBA) in 0.01 M PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
    1.2 Wash with 0.01 M PBS (pH 7.4) containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X‑100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)
    1.3 Incubation with 4% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
    1.4 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

2  **Immunolabeling**
    2.1 Blocking and permeabilization with 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X‑100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
    2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: chicken anti‑β‑III Tubulin (1:500) and rabbit anti‑GFAP (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
    2.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 2 hours)
    2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti‑chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
    2.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 2 hours)
    2.6 Nuclear staining with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
    2.7 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

3  **Dehydration and RI Matching**
    3.1 Dehydration in a graded tert‑butanol (TBA) series: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 96%, 100% (vol/vol) TBA in deionized water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)
    3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) TBA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
    3.3 Clearing and RI matching: incubation with a 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of benzyl benzoate (BB) and benzyl alcohol (BA), RI ≈ 1.56. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
    3.4 Final RI matching: incubation with pure BB/BA (2:1 vol/vol), RI = 1.56. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4  **Storage and Imaging**

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (transgenic reporter for cortical projection neurons), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-NeuN antibody]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its ability to rapidly clear and shrink large, dense tissues like the intact mouse CNS (35–40 mm), while preserving strong fluorescence signals (e.g., tdTomato) and enabling deep antibody penetration. The method’s solvent-based dehydration and delipidation efficiently render the entire CNS transparent, and its shrinkage (~65% in volume) facilitates high-resolution imaging of long-range projections across the brain–spinal cord axis. The dual-labeling strategy combines a transgenic tdTomato reporter to specifically trace cortical-origin axons with an anti-NeuN antibody (Alexa Fluor 647) to visualize surrounding neuronal somata, allowing simultaneous assessment of projection continuity, trajectory, and spatial relationship to endogenous neuronal networks.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat once)  

2  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing  
2.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG) containing 0.4% (wt/vol) vitamin E (α-tocopherol) as antioxidant (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 Replacement with fresh DBE/vitamin E solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

3  Immunostaining (Performed After Step 1.4)  
3.1 Blocking and permeabilization in PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, and 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody: mouse anti-NeuN (1:500) in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO, and 3% donkey serum (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)  
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO, and 3% donkey serum (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)  
3.6 Resume dehydration from Step 1.5 onward  

4  Storage and Imaging Preparation  
4.1 Store cleared CNS sample in fresh DBE/vitamin E solution in a light-tight container (Temperature: RT, long-term)  
4.2 Mount sample in uDISCO-compatible imaging chamber filled with DBE/vitamin E for light-sheet microscopy (Temperature: RT during imaging)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (transgenic or viral labeling of cortical projection neurons), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional clearing capability for large, dense tissues (entire mouse CNS, 35–40 mm), high transparency, and strong fluorescence preservation of red/far-red fluorophores (tdTomato, Alexa Fluor 647) over long periods. It achieves high refractive index matching (RI ~1.56) suitable for deep light-sheet imaging. The dual-labeling strategy uses tdTomato to specifically trace cortical-origin long-range projections, while anti-TUJ1 (pan-neuronal marker) labels the endogenous axonal skeleton/neuropil as a background reference, enabling clear discrimination of the specific pathway signal from the general fiber architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM, Sigma 270997) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining (Optional, if TUJ1 antibody labeling is required post-fixation)
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series (100%, 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBTx) 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.3 Blocking with PBTx containing 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody (rabbit anti-beta-III Tubulin/TUJ1, 1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBTx 6 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody (donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.7 Wash with PBTx 6 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.8 Dehydration through graded methanol series (30%, 50%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.4 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) for refractive index matching.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4  Storage and Imaging
4.1 Store cleared sample in fresh DBE in a light-tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Indefinite)
4.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (transgenic/viral tracer for long-range projections), Hoechst (nuclear counterstain for overall cytoarchitecture)]

The method preserves lipophilic dyes and fluorescent proteins (like tdTomato) well through its tert‑butanol‑ and dibenzyl ether‑based dehydration and clearing. The shrinkage also compacts the tissue, potentially improving resolution for tracing long axons across brainstem and spinal cord segments. Hoechst provides a ubiquitous nuclear reference signal to delineate gray/white matter boundaries and internal structures, aiding in the co‑localization analysis of the tdTomato‑labeled projections with endogenous pathways.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing  
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014‑1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeated once until tissue is transparent)

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (endogenous reporter for specific projection), Hoechst (for nuclear reference), Lectin (IB4, for overall vasculature/network reference)]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS (PolyEthylene Glycol-Associated Solvent System) is selected because it provides excellent tissue morphology preservation with minimal shrinkage, high transparency for large samples (up to cm-scale), and strong compatibility with endogenous fluorescent proteins (like tdTomato) and small-molecule dyes (Hoechst, Lectin). It uses a graded organic solvent dehydration and delipidation followed by benzyl alcohol/benzyl benzoate (BABB) clearing, which yields high refractive index (RI ~1.56) matching for deep imaging. This method avoids harsh bleaching steps and maintains fluorescence signal well, addressing the previous issues of shrinkage and signal loss. The labeling strategy uses endogenous tdTomato to trace specific long-range projections, Hoechst for spatial nuclear reference, and IB4 lectin to label the overall vascular/network architecture as a 3D spatial scaffold, enabling clear distinction between target fibers and background structures.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  **Dehydration and Delipidation**
    1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
    1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
    1.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
    1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
    1.5 Incubation with 95% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
    1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
    1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
    1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

2  **Refractive Index Matching and Clearing**
    2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol in 100% (vol/vol) benzyl benzoate (BABB).(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
    2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) BABB (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate = 1:2, RI ~1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3  **Labeling (Performed after fixation and before dehydration)**
    3.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
    3.2 Incubation with blocking solution (5% normal goat serum, 1% BSA, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
    3.3 Incubation with IB4 lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (10 µg/mL in PBST).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
    3.4 Wash with PBST 5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)
    3.5 Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (2 µg/mL in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
    3.6 Wash with PBS 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

4  **Sample Storage and Imaging Preparation**
    4.1 Transfer cleared sample to fresh 100% BABB for storage.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite, protected from light)
    4.2 Mount sample in BABB within an appropriate imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10/4G8 + Alexa Fluor 488, Congo red + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing depth and high transparency for whole mouse brains (up to ~1.5 cm³), strong preservation of lipophilic-dye and antibody-derived fluorescence, and compatibility with organic-solvent–resistant fluorophores (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488/647). The method yields a high refractive index (RI ~1.56) ideal for light‑sheet microscopy of entire brains. The dual‑labeling strategy uses two independent Aβ‑detection principles: the monoclonal antibody 6E10/4G8 (specific to Aβ1‑16/17‑24) and the amyloid‑binding dye Congo red (histological gold standard for amyloid plaques), each conjugated to spectrally distinct Alexa Fluor dyes. This allows spatial cross‑validation of Aβ deposits based on different epitope/structural recognition. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for anatomical registration.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2  Immunostaining and Amyloid Dye Labeling  
2.1 Blocking and permeabilization in PBSMT (PBS + 0.2% Triton X‑100 + 10% DMSO + 5% normal donkey serum) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: anti‑Aβ (6E10 or 4G8, 1:500) in PBSMT (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  
2.3 Wash with PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween‑20 + 10 mM HEPES), 6 changes over 24 hours (Temperature: RT)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: donkey anti‑mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Congo red‑Alexa Fluor 647 conjugate (10 µg/mL) in PBSMT (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  
2.5 Wash with PTwH, 6 changes over 24 hours (Temperature: RT)  
2.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.7 Wash with PBS, 3 changes over 6 hours (Temperature: RT)  

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 50%, 80%, 100% methanol series (each step: Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol, second change (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.6 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeat once until fully transparent)  

4  Refractive‑Index Matching and Storage  
4.1 Mount cleared brain in fresh DBE in an imaging‑compatible chamber (Temperature: RT, Time: equilibration 1 hour)  
4.2 Store in dark at 4 ℃ until imaging (for long‑term storage, seal chamber to prevent DBE evaporation).

**Protocol Steps:**

1  **Dehydration and Delipidation**
    1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (pH 7.4) at 4 ℃ for 1 hour. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
    1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at 4 ℃ for 1 hour. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
    1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at 4 ℃ for 1 hour. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
    1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol at 4 ℃ for 1 hour. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
    1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol at 4 ℃ for 3 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours)
    1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol at 4 ℃ for 1 hour. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

2  **Immunolabeling (Optional Pre-treatment & Staining)**
    2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, each step at 4 ℃ for 1 hour. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours total)
    2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-Tx) at 4 ℃, 3 changes, 1 hour each. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours)
    2.3 Blocking and permeabilization in PBS-Tx with 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.3 M glycine at 4 ℃ for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
    2.4 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: anti-Aβ (6E10/4G8, 1:500) in blocking solution at 4 ℃ for 7 days with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
    2.5 Wash with PBS-Tx at 4 ℃, 6 changes over 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
    2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody: donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution at 4 ℃ for 7 days with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
    2.7 Wash with PBS-Tx at 4 ℃, 6 changes over 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

    2.10 Incubation with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS at 4 ℃ for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
    2.11 Final wash with PBS at 4 ℃, 3 changes over 3 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours)

3  **Final Dehydration and Clearing**
    3.1 Dehydration through graded methanol series: 30%, 50%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS, each step at 4 ℃ for 1 hour. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 4 hours)

    3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM at 4 ℃ for 15 minutes. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 15 minutes)

Lectin labels vasculature, providing essential anatomical context for spatial analysis of plaque distribution relative to blood vessels. DAPI counterstains nuclei. **Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647 conjugate), Anti-CD31 (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate)]
**Justification:** uDISCO provides excellent transparency and high shrinkage (ideal for the ~8x6x5 mm tissue block), superior preservation of endogenous fluorescence (e.g., from potential tumor reporter lines), and long-term sample stability. The chosen labeling strategy directly addresses the scientific goal: Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum) broadly labels the vasculature endothelium and basement membrane, while anti-CD31 (PECAM-1) specifically highlights endothelial cells, enabling clear 3D reconstruction of the vascular network morphology, density, and branching. This dual-channel approach allows for precise spatial correlation between the tumor mass/invasion front (potentially visualized via endogenous fluorescence like GFP from tumor cells) and the surrounding vasculature to analyze perivascular infiltration.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 20% (vol/vol) DMSO for permeabilization.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 6% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum, and 10 mg/ml BSA).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Incubation with Primary Antibody Cocktail (PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 3% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum, 5 mg/ml BSA, 1:200 Anti-CD31 antibody, and 10 µg/ml Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.4 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with 3 solution changes)
1.5 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution (PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 3% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum, 5 mg/ml BSA, and 1:500 Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 488).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.6 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with 3 solution changes)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with Diethyl Ether (freshly opened).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (mixture of Diphenyl Ether and Tetrahydrofuran in a specific ratio, optionally with anti-oxidant).(Temperature: RT, Time: until tissue is transparent, typically 12-24 hours)

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Post-fixation wash with 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4, on a shaker.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

1.3 Primary antibody incubation with anti-Claudin-5 (rabbit, 1:200) and DyLight 649-conjugated Lycopersicon Esculentum Lectin (1:100) in incubation solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 3% donkey serum, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS) on a shaker.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.4 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-T) on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with solution changed every 8 hours)
1.5 Secondary antibody incubation with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in incubation solution on a shaker.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.6 Wash with PBS-T on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with solution changed every 8 hours)
1.7 Post-staining fixation with 4% PFA in PBS on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.8 Final wash with PBS on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2.1 Gradual dehydration in a series of tert-butanol (tB) solutions: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 96%, 100%, 100% (vol/vol in H2O) on a shaker.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)

**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing depth and high transparency in large, fixed tissue blocks (up to cm-scale), strong preservation of endogenous and antibody-induced fluorescence, and compatibility with organic-solvent-based refractive index matching (DBE, RI~1.56) ideal for high-resolution 3D imaging (e.g., light-sheet microscopy). The dual-labeling strategy targets CD31 (PECAM1) for pan-vascular endothelial visualization and Claudin-5 for tight junctions of the blood-brain barrier (BBB). This combination allows simultaneous mapping of the entire vascular network and assessment of endothelial barrier integrity, directly addressing the scientific goals of analyzing vascular co-option, remodeling, and perivascular invasion patterns in glioblastoma.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining
2.1 Rehydration through a graded methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated three times)
2.3 Blocking with PBS-T containing 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum and 10 µg/ml Fab fragment anti-mouse IgG.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Primary antibody incubation: Rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:200) and Rabbit anti-Claudin-5 (1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)
2.5 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated six times)
2.6 Secondary antibody incubation: Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)
2.7 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated six times)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin (IB4)+Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected over CUBIC for this tumor-bearing brain tissue. It provides superior preservation of tissue architecture and vascular integrity through a graded methanol dehydration and delipidation with dichloromethane (DCM), which is critical for analyzing fragile tumor boundaries and continuous vascular networks. The method is highly compatible with antibody labeling (immunolabeling-enabled) and offers excellent clearing for samples of this size (8x6x5 mm). The chosen labeling strategy targets: 1) **CD31** for pan-endothelial cell marking of the entire vascular network; 2) **Claudin-5** as a key tight junction protein for assessing blood-brain barrier (BBB) structural integrity; 3) **Lectin (IB4)** for robust labeling of the vasculature lumen, complementing CD31 and aiding in 3D reconstruction; and 4) **DAPI** for nuclear counterstain to delineate tumor and brain parenchyma. All dyes/fluorophores are within the allowed list.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Permeabilization, Blocking, and Immunolabeling
1.1 Wash fixed tissue block in PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T) for 1 hour at room temperature (RT) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation in permeabilization solution (PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 20% (vol/vol) DMSO) for 48 hours at 37°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.3 Blocking and incubation in primary antibody solution (PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum, and primary antibodies: rat anti-CD31 [1:200], rabbit anti-Claudin-5 [1:100], biotinylated IB4 Lectin [1:50]) for 7 days at 37°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.4 Wash in PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBS-Tw) for 24 hours, changing solution every 8 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.5 Incubation in secondary antibody solution (PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum, and secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 647 [1:200], donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 [1:200], streptavidin Alexa Fluor 555 [1:200]) for 7 days at 37°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.6 Wash in PBS-Tw for 24 hours, changing solution every 8 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.7 Incubation in DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBS) for 48 hours at RT with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.8 Final wash in PBS-Tw for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2  Dehydration
2.1 Incubation with a graded methanol series in distilled water: 20% (vol/vol), 40% (vol/vol), 60% (vol/vol), 80% (vol/vol), 100% (vol/vol) methanol, each for 1 hour at RT with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)
2.2 Incubation with a second change of 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3  Delipidation and Bleaching
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) for 12 hours at 4°C. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Rehydration with a descending methanol series in PBS: 80% (vol/vol), 60% (vol/vol), 40% (vol/vol), 20% (vol/vol) methanol, each for 1 hour at RT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
3.3 Wash in PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Dehydration again with an ascending methanol series in water: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, 100% methanol, each for 1 hour at RT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM, Sigma 270997) in methanol for 3 hours at RT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 15 minutes at RT (two changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes total)

4  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) for refractive index matching. Place sample in fresh 100% DBE and incubate without shaking until the tissue is fully transparent (typically 12-24 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS is selected because it achieves high transparency and excellent preservation of endogenous fluorescence (critical for weak GFP signals) through a gentle, stepwise solvent-based dehydration and clearing process. It is highly effective for thick tissue blocks (3 mm) and maintains structural integrity for long-term storage and re-imaging. The dual-target strategy uses the endogenous GFP to identify sparse reporter neurons, while MAP2 immunolabeling (with a far-red Alexa Fluor 647 secondary) robustly highlights the entire dendritic arbor and fine morphology. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for spatial orientation. This combination maximizes signal for 3D analysis of soma, dendritic branching, length, and local projection patterns.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) tert-butanol (tB) in deionized water. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
1.2 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) tB in deionized water. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
1.3 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) tB in deionized water. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
1.4 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) tB in deionized water. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
1.5 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) tB. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
1.6 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) tB with fresh replacement after 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  
1.7 Incubation in 50% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol (BA) and 50% (vol/vol) tB. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
1.8 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) BA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
1.9 Incubation in fresh 100% (vol/vol) BA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

2  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing  
2.1 Incubation in 50% (vol/vol) BA and 50% (vol/vol) benzyl benzoate (BB). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.2 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) BB (RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.3 Incubation in fresh 100% (vol/vol) BB for final clearing and storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

3  Immunolabeling (Optional, performed after Step 1.5 if required for enhanced MAP2 signal)  
3.1 Rehydration through a reverse tB series (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% tB in deionized water). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)  
3.2 Wash in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 3 repeats)  
3.3 Blocking in PBST with 5% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.4 Incubation with primary antibody (chicken anti-MAP2, 1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.5 Wash in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 3 repeats)  
3.6 Incubation with secondary antibody (donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) and DAPI (1 µg/mL) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.7 Wash in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 3 repeats)  
3.8 Resume dehydration from Step 1.1.  

4  Long-Term Storage and Pre-Imaging  
4.1 Store cleared tissue in 100% BB in a light-tight container at 4 ℃.  
4.2 For imaging, mount tissue in 100% BB within an appropriate imaging chamber.  
4.3 For re-imaging after storage, briefly rinse in fresh 100% BB to remove potential crystals.

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [内源荧光信号 (如 tdTomato 或 GFP), Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2-Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS (Polyethylene glycol (PEG)-Associated Solvent System) 方法适用于较厚组织块（3 mm 小鼠脑组织），能极好地保留内源荧光信号（如稀疏报告基因表达的 tdTomato/GFP），并有效减少荧光淬灭。其基于有机溶剂的脱水和脱脂步骤能良好保存细胞骨架和树突结构，且最终折射率匹配溶液（如 BABB-D或 TDE）兼容长期保存（6个月）。选择 Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647 标记 F-actin 以勾勒神经元胞体和树突轮廓，MAP2-Alexa Fluor 488 抗体标记树突微管，从而在微弱内源信号基础上补全形态细节，实现双靶点（内源报告蛋白 + 细胞骨架/树突标记）共标记。

**Protocol Steps:**
1 脱水与透化
1.1 梯度脱水：依次在 30%、50%、70%、80%、95%、100% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 每步 4 小时)
1.2 脱脂与透明化：在 1:2 (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷/叔丁醇混合液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 小时)
1.3 脱脂：在 100% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 分钟)

2 免疫标记
2.1 再水化与封闭：将样本转移至含 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 和 5% (wt/vol) 驴血清的 PBS 中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 小时)
2.2 一抗孵育：在含 0.2% Triton X-100、5% 驴血清的 PBS 中加入 anti-MAP2 抗体 (1:500) 和 Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200)。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 天)
2.3 洗涤：用含 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 的 PBS 洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 2 小时，共 6 次)
2.4 二抗孵育（如需要）：在含 0.2% Triton X-100、5% 驴血清的 PBS 中加入驴抗小鼠 Alexa Fluor 488 二抗 (1:500)。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 天)
2.5 洗涤：用含 0.1% Tween-20 的 PBS 洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 2 小时，共 6 次)

3 最终脱水与折射率匹配
3.1 梯度脱水：依次在 30%、50%、70%、80%、95%、100% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 每步 4 小时)
3.2 折射率匹配与长期保存：在 97% (vol/vol) 2,2'-硫代二乙醇 (TDE) 水溶液 (折射率 ~1.52) 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 小时，随后可于 4 ℃ 密封避光保存长达 6 个月)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), NeuN (RBFOX3)+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS (Polyethylene glycol (PEG)-Associated Solvent System) 是一种基于有机溶剂的透明化方法，具有极佳的荧光信号长期保存能力（可超过一年），非常适合计划保存6个月后进行重复成像的需求。它对内源弱荧光信号（如稀疏报告小鼠的GFP）保护性好，且能有效维持组织形态和抗原性，便于后续进行免疫标记（如NeuN）以增强神经元识别和获取结构信息。该方法适用于3 mm厚的脑组织块，透明速度快，折射率匹配后适合高分辨率三维成像（如光片显微镜）。

**Protocol Steps:**
1 脱水与脱脂
1.1 梯度脱水：依次在20%、40%、60%、80%、100% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 每步2小时)
1.2 脱脂：在100% (vol/vol) 二苄醚（DBE）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时)

2 折射率匹配与透明化
2.1 折射率匹配液A孵育：在PEGASOS溶液A（85% (vol/vol) 四氢呋喃，15% (vol/vol) 聚乙二醇400， RI ≈ 1.46）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12小时)
2.2 折射率匹配液B孵育：在PEGASOS溶液B（50% (vol/vol) 四氢呋喃，25% (vol/vol) 聚乙二醇400，25% (vol/vol) 碘克沙醇， RI ≈ 1.48）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12小时)

3 免疫标记（针对NeuN，增强神经元识别）
3.1 再水化：将透明化组织依次转移至100%、80%、60%、40%、20% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，最后转移至PBS。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步1小时)
3.2 透化与封闭：在含0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100和5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清的PBS中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时)
3.3 一抗孵育：在含抗NeuN一抗（如小鼠抗NeuN，1:500）和0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的封闭液中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72小时)
3.4 洗涤：用含0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的PBS洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次4小时，共洗涤4次)
3.5 二抗孵育：在含Alexa Fluor 647偶联驴抗小鼠IgG二抗（1:500）和0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的封闭液中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72小时)
3.6 洗涤：用含0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的PBS洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次4小时，共洗涤4次)

4 长期保存前处理
4.1 最终脱水：将标记后的组织依次在20%、40%、60%、80%、100% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步2小时)
4.2 最终透明与保存：将组织转移至PEGASOS溶液B中，密封避光保存于4℃。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期保存)

**Chosen Labeling:** [内源 GFP/EGFP/YFP (保留), MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647 (补全树突), DAPI (核染色)]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS (Polyethylene glycol (PEG)-Associated Solvent System) 是一种基于有机溶剂但包含PEG的透明化方法，具有极强的荧光保护能力，尤其适合微弱的内源荧光蛋白（如GFP/YFP）的长期保留。其步骤温和，能有效避免荧光淬灭和背景升高。通过折射率匹配溶液（BB-PEGASOS）可实现高透明度和低光散射，非常适合3 mm厚组织块。结合MAP2抗体标记（使用Alexa Fluor 647偶联）可以高分辨率补全神经元树突和胞体形态，且Alexa Fluor 647在PEGASOS体系中非常稳定。DAPI用于核定位。整个流程兼容长期（6个月以上）在折射率匹配液中4℃避光保存，信号衰减极低。

**Protocol Steps:**

1  **脱水与去色素**
    1.1 梯度脱水：将固定后的3 mm小鼠脑组织块依次浸入20%、40%、60%、80%、100% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇 (t-butanol) 水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 每步2小时)
    1.2 完全脱水：更换为新鲜100%叔丁醇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12小时)

2  **脂质清除与透明化**
    2.1 脂溶处理：将样本转移至PEGASOS脱脂液（含5% (vol/vol) 聚乙二醇400 (PEG400) 的二氯甲烷 (DCM) 溶液）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时，避光，轻微摇动)
    2.2 透明化：将样本转移至BB-PEGASOS透明化液A（苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2 (vol/vol)，含10% (vol/vol) PEG400）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时，避光)

3  **免疫标记（树突结构补全）**
    3.1 再水化与通透：将透明化样本逆向梯度转移回100%、80%、60%叔丁醇/PBS溶液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步2小时)
    3.2 洗涤：在含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的PBS (PBST) 中洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 x 1小时)
    3.3 封闭：在含5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清和0.2% Triton X-100的PBST中封闭。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12小时)
    3.4 一抗孵育：在封闭液中加入小鼠抗MAP2一抗（建议稀释比1:500）和DAPI (1 µg/mL)。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72小时，轻微摇动，避光)
    3.5 洗涤：用PBST洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 2小时)
    3.6 二抗孵育：在含0.2% Triton X-100的PBST中加入驴抗小鼠IgG Alexa Fluor 647二抗（建议稀释比1:500）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72小时，轻微摇动，避光)
    3.7 最终洗涤：用PBST洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 2小时)

4  **最终透明化与折射率匹配**
    4.1 脱水：将样本依次浸入20%、40%、60%、80%、100%叔丁醇/PBS溶液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步2小时)
    4.2 最终透明化：将样本转移至BB-PEGASOS透明化液B（苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2，含20% (vol/vol) PEG400，折射率RI ~1.48）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时，避光)

5  **长期保存与成像前处理**
    5.1 保存：将样本浸没在新鲜的BB-PEGASOS透明化液B中，密封于避光容器。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 可长期保存≥6个月)
    5.2 成像前准备：成像前将样本转移至充满BB-PEGASOS液的成像腔室中，确保无气泡。

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN+Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 555]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional ability to preserve endogenous fluorescence (crucial for antibody-based labeling), achieve high transparency in dense, lipid-rich tissues like fixed human brain, and provide strong tissue shrinkage which can be beneficial for imaging thick (5 mm) samples. The dual-labeling strategy using NeuN (mature neuronal nuclei) and MAP2 (neuronal dendrites/cytoplasm) allows for unambiguous identification, 3D localization, and morphological analysis of mature neurons throughout the cortical layers.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Immunostaining
1.1 Permeabilization and Blocking: Incubation with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, mouse anti-NeuN (1:500) and chicken anti-MAP2 (1:1000). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.3 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with solution changed every 8 hours)
1.4 Secondary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-chicken IgG Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.5 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with solution changed every 8 hours)
1.6 Final Wash: Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2  Dehydration
2.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeated once with fresh methanol)

3  Delipidation and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated once)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, until tissue is fully transparent)

4  Refractive Index Matching and Storage
4.1 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours for equilibration)
4.2 Storage: Mount and image the sample in 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, for long-term storage keep in dark at 4 ℃)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN+Alexa Fluor 488, Hu C/D+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing of large, lipid‑rich human brain samples (5 mm thick), strong fluorescence preservation for Alexa Fluor dyes, and compatibility with antibody penetration after mild delipidation. The dual nuclear/cytoplasmic markers NeuN (mature neuron nuclear marker) and Hu C/D (pan‑neuronal cytoplasmic marker) provide complementary signals for reliable neuron identification and spatial mapping across cortical layers and perilesional areas. DAPI is included for general nuclear counterstaining.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)  

2  Rehydration and Permeabilization  
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X‑100 (PBST) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated three times)  

3  Immunostaining  
3.1 Blocking with PBST containing 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 10 mg/mL bovine serum albumin (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: mouse anti‑NeuN (1:500) and rabbit anti‑Hu C/D (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
3.3 Wash with PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeated six times)  
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti‑mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
3.5 Wash with PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeated six times)  
3.6 Nuclear counterstaining with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.7 Wash with PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated three times)  

4  Final Dehydration and Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)  
4.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)  
4.7 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014‑1KG) for refractive‑index matching (RI ≈ 1.56) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, repeated once)  

5  Storage and Imaging  
5.1 Store cleared sample in fresh DBE in a light‑tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging.  
5.2 For imaging, mount sample in a chamber filled with DBE and image using light‑sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate filter sets for DAPI, Alexa Fluor 488, and Alexa Fluor 647.

**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** SeeDB2 is an aqueous, rapid, and fluorescence-friendly clearing method ideal for 500 μm fixed brain slices. It achieves high transparency within hours while preserving endogenous GFP and antibody-labeled fluorescence. The protocol is simple, uses common reagents, and meets the 1‑day timeline. Endogenous GFP labels sparse pyramidal neurons, while MAP2 antibody (conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647) stains dendrites, enabling clear visualization of dendritic shafts and spines for density analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 样本预处理与免疫标记
1.1 切片在 PBS 中洗涤 3 次，每次 10 分钟，去除残留固定剂。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 分钟)
1.2 透化与封闭：在含 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 和 5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 小时)
1.3 一抗孵育：在含 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100、1% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清的 PBS 中加入小鼠抗 MAP2 抗体 (1:500)。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 小时)
1.4 洗涤：用含 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的 PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 30 分钟。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 小时)
1.5 二抗孵育：在含 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100、1% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清的 PBS 中加入驴抗小鼠 Alexa Fluor 647 抗体 (1:500)。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 小时，避光)
1.6 洗涤：用 PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 20 分钟。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 小时，避光)

2 SeeDB2 透明化处理
2.1 梯度脱水：依次在 20%、40%、60%、80%、100% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液中孵育，每步 30 分钟。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2.5 小时，避光)
2.2 透明化：在 SeeDB2 溶液（85.7% (wt/vol) 果糖，0.5% (vol/vol) α-硫代甘油，0.5% (vol/vol) 1‑硫代甘油，溶于去离子水，RI≈1.52）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 小时，避光)

3 折射率匹配与成像前处理
3.1 成像前平衡：将切片转移至新鲜 SeeDB2 溶液，静置 30 分钟。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 分钟，避光)
3.2 封片：将切片置于载玻片或成像腔中，用 SeeDB2 溶液覆盖，盖上盖玻片，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 立即成像)
3.3 成像：使用共聚焦或光片显微镜进行 3D 成像，激发波长分别为 488 nm (GFP) 和 640 nm (Alexa Fluor 647)。(Temperature: RT, Time: 根据成像范围而定)

**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** SeeDB2 is an aqueous, simple, and rapid clearing method ideal for thin-to-medium-thickness tissue slices (like 500 μm). It preserves endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP) exceptionally well and maintains fine structural details, which is critical for resolving dendritic spines and small branches. The protocol can be completed within one day. The dual-target strategy uses endogenous GFP signal from sparse labeling (e.g., Thy1-GFP mice) to visualize spines and fine dendrites, while an anti-MAP2 antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 provides strong, complementary labeling of the entire dendritic arbor for skeletonization and length normalization analysis. Both fluorophores are compatible with SeeDB2's refractive index matching solution.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 免疫标记 (如需要，在透明化前进行)
1.1 样本在含0.3% Triton X-100的PBS中透化。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 在含10%正常驴血清和0.3% Triton X-100的PBS中封闭。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 在封闭液中孵育抗MAP2一抗 (例如，鸡源抗MAP2，1:500)。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12-16 hours)
1.4 用含0.1% Triton X-100的PBS洗涤样本3次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次1小时)
1.5 在封闭液中孵育驴抗鸡Alexa Fluor 647二抗 (1:500)。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4-6小时，避光)
1.6 用含0.1% Triton X-100的PBS洗涤样本3次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次1小时，避光)

2 SeeDB2 透明化处理
2.1 在20% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.2 在40% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.3 在60% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.4 在80% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.5 在100% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.6 在SeeDB2S溶液 (88.2% (wt/vol) 果糖，0.5% (vol/vol) α-硫代甘油，溶于水) 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3 折射率匹配与封片
3.1 将样本转移至成像皿，并浸没在新鲜的SeeDB2S溶液中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 直至成像)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-MAP2 antibody]  
**Justification:** SeeDB2 is an aqueous, rapid, and simple clearing method that preserves endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP) exceptionally well and causes minimal tissue swelling/shrinkage, which is critical for accurate morphometric analysis of dendritic spines. It can clear 500 μm-thick slices within hours, fitting the 1-day timeline. The dual-target strategy uses endogenous GFP to label the pyramidal neurons (e.g., Thy1-GFP mouse line) for spine visualization, while immunostaining for MAP2 (a dendritic marker) provides a reference signal for dendritic orientation and segment selection, enabling reliable spine density calculation per unit dendrite length.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 样本预处理与免疫标记
1.1 洗涤固定后脑切片（500 μm）于 PBS 中，3 次，每次 10 分钟。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.2 透化与封闭：在含 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 和 5% (wt/vol) 正常驴血清的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 一抗孵育：在含 1% (wt/vol) 正常驴血清和 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的 PBS 中，加入兔源抗-MAP2 一抗（建议稀释比 1:500）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 洗涤：在含 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的 PBS 中洗涤，3 次，每次 30 分钟。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.5 二抗孵育：在含 1% (wt/vol) 正常驴血清和 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的 PBS 中，加入 Alexa Fluor 647 标记的驴抗兔二抗（建议稀释比 1:500）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.6 洗涤：在 PBS 中洗涤，3 次，每次 20 分钟。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 SeeDB2 透明化处理
2.1 梯度脱水：依次在 20%、40%、60%、80%、100% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步 30 分钟)
2.2 透明化：在 SeeDB2S 溶液（200% (wt/vol) 果糖，0.5% (wt/vol) α-硫代甘油，溶于去离子水）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.3 折射率匹配：将样本转移至 SeeDB2G 溶液（200% (wt/vol) 果糖，0.5% (wt/vol) α-硫代甘油，溶于 50% (vol/vol) 甘油水溶液）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

3 成像前处理与保存
3.1 封片：将透明化样本置于 SeeDB2G 溶液中，使用垫片和盖玻片在载玻片上封片，避免气泡。
3.2 短期保存：封片后的样本可于 4 ℃ 避光保存，建议在 24 小时内成像以获得最佳信号。
3.3 成像准备：使用折射率匹配的浸油（RI ~1.52）进行共聚焦或光片显微镜成像。

**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** SeeDB2 is an aqueous, high-refractive-index (RI) matching method that is exceptionally fast (hours), causes minimal tissue swelling/shrinkage (<5%), and preserves endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP) and lipophilic dye signals well. It is ideal for 300–500 μm thick fixed brain slices where rapid, low-distortion 3D imaging of fine neuronal structures (dendrites and spines) is required. The addition of an anti-MAP2 antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 provides a robust, high-contrast dendritic backbone label to complement sparse endogenous GFP signal, enabling reliable skeletonization and spine density normalization.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 免疫标记 (适用于 300 μm 切片)
1.1 通透与封闭：将切片浸于含 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 和 5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清的 PBS 中，于摇床上轻柔孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 小时)
1.2 一抗孵育：将切片转移至含 1:500 小鼠抗 MAP2 一抗 (例如 ab11267) 和 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的封闭液中，于摇床上轻柔孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 小时)
1.3 洗涤：用含 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的 PBS (PBST) 洗涤切片 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 30 分钟)
1.4 二抗孵育：将切片转移至含 1:500 Alexa Fluor 647 标记驴抗小鼠 IgG 二抗和 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的封闭液中，于摇床上轻柔孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 小时)
1.5 洗涤：用 PBST 洗涤切片 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 30 分钟)

2 SeeDB2 透明化处理
2.1 梯度脱水：依次将切片浸入以下溶液，于摇床上轻柔孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步 30 分钟)
2.1.1 20% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液。
2.1.2 40% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液。
2.1.3 60% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液。
2.1.4 80% (wt/vol) 果糖水溶液。
2.2 RI 匹配与透明化：将切片浸入 SeeDB2S 溶液 (88.2% (wt/vol) 果糖，0.5% (vol/vol) α-硫代甘油，RI ≈ 1.49) 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 小时)
2.3 最终 RI 匹配：将切片转移至新鲜的 SeeDB2S 溶液中，准备成像。(Temperature: RT, Time: 过夜或至少 6 小时)

3 保存与成像前处理
3.1 封片：将透明化后的切片置于成像皿中，用足量 SeeDB2S 溶液覆盖，避免产生气泡。
3.2 短期保存：成像前，可将样本在 SeeDB2S 溶液中于 4 ℃ 避光保存。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 可达 1 周)

1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining and Morphology Labeling
2.1 Rehydration through a descending methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 3 times)
2.3 Blocking with PBS-T containing 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Labeling:** [beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Hu C/D / PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency in whole embryos (8–10 mm) with strong shrinkage (∼60% volume reduction), which enhances resolution and penetration for deep imaging. It preserves fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes exceptionally well over months, enabling long-term storage and repeated imaging. The protocol is relatively fast (∼3 days) and compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling. The dual-labeling strategy targets both mature nerve bundles (beta-III Tubulin, highly expressed in axons of projecting neurons) and early/diffuse neuronal processes (Hu C/D / PGP9.5, a pan-neuronal marker present in cell bodies and developing neurites), allowing simultaneous 3D visualization of established tracts and pioneering extensions in the same embryo.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)  
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  

2  Immunolabeling  
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series (100%, 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes each)  
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)  
2.3 Blocking with PBS-T containing 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: chicken anti-beta-III Tubulin (1:500) and rabbit anti-Hu C/D / PGP9.5 (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)  
2.5 Wash with PBS-T (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeat 6 times)  
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)  
2.7 Wash with PBS-T (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeat 6 times)  

3  Dehydration for Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647, anti-beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1)-Alexa Fluor 488]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional clearing depth and shrinkage reduction, crucial for preserving the delicate architecture of an 8-10 mm E12.5 embryo and enabling high-resolution 3D tracing of fine neuronal projections. It offers excellent fluorescence preservation for Alexa Fluor dyes. The dual-labeling strategy targets F-actin (Phalloidin) to outline overall tissue and cellular morphology, and beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1) to specifically label developing axons and neuronal processes. This combination increases reliability in distinguishing neural projections from background structures during 3D reconstruction.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Immunostaining and Morphology Labeling
1.1 Permeabilization and Blocking: Incubation with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 1% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum, and anti-beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody (1:500). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.3 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with 3 solution changes)
1.4 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Incubation: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 1% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum, Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated donkey anti-mouse IgG (1:500), and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated Phalloidin (1:200). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.5 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with 3 solution changes)
1.6 Final Rinse: Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Dehydration: Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Dehydration: Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Dehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Dehydration: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
2.5 Delipidation: Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.6 Delipidation: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Clearing Initiation: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.2 Final Clearing: Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, or until fully transparent)

4  Mounting and Storage
4.1 Mounting: Transfer cleared embryo to a glass-bottom imaging dish filled with 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT)
4.2 Storage: Store sample in the dark at 4 ℃ in 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE) until imaging.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 647, Hu C/D / PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 555, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 488]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional clearing depth and fluorescence preservation in large, dense tissues like whole E12.5 embryos. It achieves high transparency and low background, crucial for deep imaging of fine neuronal projections. The chosen triple-labeling strategy covers the scientific goals: beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labels mature neuronal tracts and axons, Hu C/D (PGP9.5) labels early and mature neuronal cell bodies and processes, and Lectin (e.g., Isolectin GS-IB4) labels vasculature, providing essential anatomical context for nerve pathfinding. Using Alexa Fluor dyes ensures bright, photostable signals compatible with uDISCO's solvent-based process.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Immunostaining
1.1 Permeabilization and Blocking: Incubation with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, and the following primary antibodies: chicken anti-beta-III Tubulin (1:500), rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500), and biotinylated Isolectin GS-IB4 (1:100). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.3 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with solution changed every 8 hours)
1.4 Secondary Antibody and Streptavidin Incubation: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, and the following reagents: donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500), and streptavidin Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.5 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with solution changed every 8 hours)
1.6 Dehydration: Incubation with a graded series of tetrahydrofuran (THF) in water: 30% (vol/vol), 50% (vol/vol), 70% (vol/vol), 80% (vol/vol), 100% (vol/vol), and a second 100% (vol/vol) THF step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)
2  Delipidation and Clearing
2.1 Delipidation: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.2 RI Matching and Clearing: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, until the embryo is fully transparent)
3  Storage and Imaging
3.1 Storage: The cleared embryo is stored in fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in a light-tight vial. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinitely)
3.2 Mounting for Imaging: The embryo is mounted in a custom imaging chamber filled with 100% (vol/vol) DBE.

1.5 Wash with PBS-T (0.5% Triton X-100), 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

2.1 Incubation with 30% (wt/vol) fructose in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
