**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Hu C/D (PGP9.5)-Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional clearing depth and shrinkage-minimizing properties, crucial for preserving the delicate 3D architecture of the ~4 mm zebrafish larva and the fine neural projections of the lateral line nerve. It effectively preserves endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP/YFP if present) and antibody/Phalloidin signals. Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 directly labels F-actin in the stereociliary bundles of hair cells. The anti-Hu C/D (PGP9.5) antibody is a pan-neuronal marker ideal for labeling the entire lateral line nerve fibers, allowing clear visualization of innervation patterns and spatial relationships with hair cell clusters.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Permeabilization, Blocking, and Staining
1.1 Incubation with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) for permeabilization.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 1% (wt/vol) bovine serum albumin (BSA), 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.3 Incubation with primary antibody solution (Rabbit anti-Hu C/D (PGP9.5), 1:500 dilution in blocking solution).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.4 Washing with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with secondary antibody and phalloidin solution (Goat anti-Rabbit IgG-Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500; Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488, 1:200; in blocking solution).(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.6 Washing with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 1 hour)

2  Dehydration and Solvent Transition
2.1 Incubation with a graded methanol series in PBS: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80% methanol (each vol/vol in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each step)
2.2 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 x 1 hour)

3  uDISCO Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 x 15 minutes)
3.3 Incubation with 100% Diethyl Ether (freshly opened).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.4 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (85% (vol/vol) Diethyl Ether, 15% (vol/vol) Diphenyl Ether).(Temperature: RT, Time: until fully cleared, typically 12-24 hours)

4  Refractive Index Matching and Storage
4.1 Mounting in fresh uDISCO clearing solution within an imaging chamber.(Temperature: RT, Time: N/A)
4.2 Imaging performed directly in uDISCO solution (RI ~1.56). For long-term storage, samples can be kept in uDISCO solution at 4°C in the dark.

**Chosen Method:** ScaleS (modified protocol with graded ScaleS0 incubation to prevent osmotic shock)
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (for F-actin), HuC/D-Alexa Fluor 647 (for hair cell identity), DAPI (for nuclei)]
**Justification:** The original problem was osmotic shock and fluorescence loss from a rapid transition from ScaleS0 to ScaleS4. The standard ScaleS method is ideal for small, delicate zebrafish larvae as it is aqueous, gentle, and compatible with endogenous fluorescent proteins and dyes like Phalloidin. By implementing a graded, multi-day incubation in ScaleS0, we minimize tissue swelling and preserve fluorescence. Phalloidin directly labels F-actin in stereociliary bundles. HuC/D is an excellent pan-neuronal marker that robustly labels zebrafish lateral line hair cells. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain. This combination allows for simultaneous identification of hair cell bodies (HuC/D) and their apical actin structures (Phalloidin) in a cleared, intact 5 dpf larva.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Immunostaining and Phalloidin Labeling (Post-Fixation)
1.1 Permeabilization and Blocking: Incubation with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.2 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with mouse anti-HuC/D (1:200) in PBS with 0.5% Triton X-100 and 1% normal goat serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.3 Wash: Three washes with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
1.4 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Incubation: Incubation with goat anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated Phalloidin (1:100) in PBS with 0.5% Triton X-100 and 1% normal goat serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.5 Wash: Three washes with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
1.6 Nuclear Counterstain: Incubation with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.7 Final Wash: Two washes with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per wash)

2  Graded Tissue Clearing with ScaleS0
2.1 Equilibration: Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) ScaleS0 (4M Urea, 10% (wt/vol) Glycerol, 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100) in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Transition: Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ScaleS0 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.3 Full ScaleS0 Incubation: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ScaleS0.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours, with solution refreshed at 24 hours)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Final Clearing
3.1 RI Matching: Incubation with ScaleS4 (50% (wt/vol) D-Sorbitol, 25% (wt/vol) Urea, 10% (wt/vol) Glycerol, 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, RI ~1.38).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Final Clearing/Storage: Transfer sample to fresh ScaleS4 for imaging or storage.(Temperature: RT or 4 ℃ for long-term, Time: Ready for imaging)

**Chosen Method:** ClearSee  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP/YFP (endogenous), SCRI Renaissance 2200]  
**Justification:** ClearSee is specifically developed for plant tissues, effectively decolorizing chlorophyll while preserving endogenous fluorescent protein signals (GFP/YFP) and compatible with direct cell-wall staining dyes like SCRI Renaissance 2200. It uses mild, aqueous-based reagents that maintain tissue integrity and fluorescence over weeks, making it ideal for intact Arabidopsis seedlings (15–20 mm) to visualize 3D expression patterns in roots, vasculature, and shoots without antibody labeling.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  **Dehydration and Chlorophyll Removal**  
1.1 Incubation with ClearSee solution (10% w/v xylitol, 15% w/v sodium deoxycholate, 25% w/v urea in water) for 1 week with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)  
1.2 Replacement with fresh ClearSee solution and incubation for an additional 1 week. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)  

2  **Cell Wall Staining**  
2.1 Incubation with SCRI Renaissance 2200 (diluted 1:1000 in ClearSee solution) for 2 days with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

3  **Wash**  
3.1 Rinse with ClearSee solution (without dye) for 1 day to remove excess stain. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

4  **Refractive Index Matching**  
4.1 Incubation with 50% (wt/vol) sucrose in ClearSee solution for 1 day. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with 70% (wt/vol) sucrose in ClearSee solution for 1 day. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.3 Mounting in 70% (wt/vol) sucrose in ClearSee solution for imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: N/A)

    1.1 Wash fixed seedlings in 1x PBS for 30 minutes, three times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)

    2.1 Incubate cleared seedlings in ClearSee solution containing 0.1% (wt/vol) SCRI Renaissance 2200 (SR2200). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2-3 days, protected from light)

3  **Refractive Index Matching and Mounting**
    3.1 Optional dehydration for deeper clearing: Incubate seedlings in a graded series of ClearSee:glycerol mixtures (3:1, 1:1, 1:3 v/v), 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

**Chosen Method:** ClearSee  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP/YFP (endogenous), SCRI Renaissance 2200]  
**Justification:** ClearSee is specifically developed for plant tissues, effectively clearing chlorophyll-rich organs (like cotyledons and leaves) while preserving endogenous fluorescent protein signals (GFP/YFP) and allowing subsequent staining of cell walls. It is compatible with whole seedlings (15–20 mm) and maintains tissue morphology. SCRI Renaissance 2200 is a superior cell wall stain for cleared plant tissues, providing bright, stable fluorescence that clearly delineates epidermal, cortical, endodermal, and vascular cell walls, enabling precise co‑localization with the transgenic GFP/YFP signal.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Sample Preparation and Clearing
1.1 Wash fixed seedlings in 1× PBS, pH 7.4, three times for 10 minutes each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes total)
1.2 Incubate samples in ClearSee solution (10% (wt/vol) xylitol, 15% (wt/vol) sodium deoxycholate, 25% (wt/vol) urea in water) without shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7–14 days, with solution change every 3–4 days)

2  Cell Wall Staining
2.1 After clearing, wash samples in ClearSee solution for 1 hour to equilibrate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubate samples in ClearSee solution containing 0.1% (wt/vol) SCRI Renaissance 2200. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3–5 days, protected from light)

3  Washing and Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Wash stained samples in fresh ClearSee solution three times for 6 hours each to remove excess dye. (Temperature: RT, Time: 18 hours total)
3.2 For imaging, mount samples in ClearSee solution or optionally in 50% (wt/vol) sucrose in ClearSee for higher refractive index (RI ~1.45). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour equilibration before imaging)

**Chosen Method:** ClearSee
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP/YFP (endogenous), SCRI Renaissance 2200]
**Justification:** ClearSee is explicitly mentioned in the original workflow and is well-suited for plant tissues, particularly for preserving endogenous fluorescent protein signals (GFP/YFP) while effectively decolorizing chlorophyll. The addition of SCRI Renaissance 2200, a cell wall stain compatible with ClearSee, allows for simultaneous visualization of tissue architecture without requiring genetic modification or antibodies, perfectly aligning with the goal of co-localizing reporter signals with cellular context.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Chlorophyll Removal and Clearing
1.1 Incubation with ClearSee solution (10% (w/v) xylitol, 15% (w/v) sodium deoxycholate, 25% (w/v) urea in distilled water).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7-14 days with solution changes every 2-3 days)
1.2 Wash with 50% (v/v) ClearSee solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Wash with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 3 times)

2  Cell Wall Staining
2.1 Incubation with SCRI Renaissance 2200 staining solution (0.1% (w/v) SCRI Renaissance 2200 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 days in the dark)
2.2 Wash with PBS to remove excess stain.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 3 times in the dark)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Mounting
3.1 Incubation with 50% (v/v) ClearSee solution in 80% (v/v) glycerol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 80% (v/v) glycerol in PBS for refractive index matching and mounting.(Temperature: RT, Time: Overnight or until tissue sinks)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [alpha-bungarotoxin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 or 647, beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555 or 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous, hydrophilic clearing method that preserves endogenous fluorescence and is highly effective for soft tissues like skeletal muscle. It provides excellent transparency for samples of this size (8×5×3 mm) and is compatible with antibody and small-molecule dye labeling. Alpha-bungarotoxin directly and specifically labels postsynaptic acetylcholine receptors (AChRs), providing a robust signal for NMJ endplates. Beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody labels motor nerve terminals and axons, enabling simultaneous visualization of pre- and postsynaptic structures. DAPI labels nuclei for spatial reference. CUBIC’s gentle, non‑solvent‑based process maintains protein epitopes and fluorescent conjugates, which is critical for quantifying NMJ morphology, nerve‑terminal coverage, and regional distribution.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Wash fixed gastrocnemius muscle in PBS with 0.1% Triton X‑100 (PBST) for 1 hour at room temperature with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubate in CUBIC‑L (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% N‑N‑dimethylformamide, 15 wt% Triton X‑100 in water) for 3 days with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

2  Immunostaining and Direct Labeling  
2.1 Wash tissue 3 times in PBST, 1 hour each wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
2.2 Block in 5% normal goat serum + 1% BSA in PBST for 24 hours at room temperature. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubate with primary antibody: rabbit anti‑beta‑III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) in blocking solution for 5 days at room temperature with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 120 hours)  
2.4 Wash tissue 3 times in PBST, 2 hours each wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.5 Incubate with secondary antibody: goat anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647‑conjugated alpha‑bungarotoxin (2 µg/mL) in blocking solution for 5 days at room temperature with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 120 hours)  
2.6 Wash tissue 3 times in PBST, 2 hours each wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.7 Incubate with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBST for 24 hours at room temperature. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

3  Refractive‑Index Matching and Clearing  
3.1 Wash tissue in PBS for 6 hours to remove residual detergent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.2 Incubate in CUBIC‑R1 (44 wt% sucrose, 22 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2′,2″‑nitrilotriethanol in water, RI ≈ 1.48) for 2 days at room temperature with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
3.3 Transfer to CUBIC‑R2 (47 wt% sucrose, 30 wt% urea, 15 wt% 2,2′,2″‑nitrilotriethanol in water, RI ≈ 1.52) for 2 days at room temperature with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

4  Mounting and Imaging  
4.1 Place cleared muscle in a glass‑bottom dish or chamber filled with fresh CUBIC‑R2. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate)  
4.2 Image using light‑sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate filter sets for Alexa Fluor 488/647 (AChRs), Alexa Fluor 555 (nerve terminals), and DAPI (nuclei).

The labeling strategy directly addresses the scientific goals: alpha-bungarotoxin-Alexa Fluor 647 specifically labels postsynaptic AChR clusters, Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 outlines F-actin in myofibers for structural reference, and anti-beta-III Tubulin-Alexa Fluor 555 labels the axonal cytoskeleton to visualize motor nerve terminals and axons.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining and Labeling
2.1 Blocking and permeabilization with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: anti-beta-III Tubulin (1:500) in PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 1% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody and probe cocktail: Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG-Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500), alpha-bungarotoxin-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200), and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200) in PBS-T with 1% normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

1.2 Permeabilization and blocking with incubation in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% normal goat serum, and 1% BSA.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.3 Primary antibody incubation with anti-beta-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody diluted 1:500 in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.4 Wash sample in PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBS-T), 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
1.5 Secondary antibody incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated goat anti-mouse IgG (H+L) diluted 1:500 in blocking solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.6 Wash sample in PBS-T, 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
1.7 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 555-conjugated alpha-bungarotoxin (2 µg/mL) and DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.8 Final wash in PBS, 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per wash)

2.1 Dehydration in a graded methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
2.2 Delipidation in incubation with 66% Dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% Methanol (vol/vol).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3.1 Incubation with fresh uDISCO solution: 4:2:1 mixture of Benzyl Ether (DBE) : Dichloromethane (DCM) : Methanol (MeOH), vol/vol/vol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647, Hu C/D+Alexa Fluor 488, Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency and significant tissue shrinkage (up to 65% in volume), which is advantageous for imaging a relatively large, dense organ like the whole mouse stomach (20×15×8 mm). The shrinkage improves imaging depth and resolution while preserving fluorescence of protein-based labels (e.g., Alexa Fluor conjugates) through the dehydration and delipidation steps. The method is compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling and provides a stable, hydrophobic final medium suitable for long-term storage and high-resolution light-sheet microscopy. The labeling strategy uses two well-established pan-neuronal markers (PGP9.5 and Hu C/D) to comprehensively outline the entire gastric innervation network, with Phalloidin and DAPI providing structural context for muscle layers and nuclei, respectively.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
2.1 Incubation with fresh dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeated once until tissue is transparent)

3  Immunolabeling (Performed after Step 1.4)
3.1 Rehydration through a graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, each step for 1 hour at RT.
3.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-Tx) for 2 hours at RT.
3.3 Blocking and permeabilization in PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.4 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and mouse anti-Hu C/D (1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash with PBS-Tx, 6 changes over 48 hours at RT.
3.6 Incubation with secondary antibody and dye cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 555 (1:200), and DAPI (5 µg/mL) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.7 Wash with PBS-Tx, 6 changes over 48 hours at RT.
3.8 Dehydration through a graded methanol series in PBS: 30%, 50%, 80%, 100% methanol, each step for 1 hour at RT.
3.9 Proceed to Step 1.5 for final clearing.

4  Storage and Imaging
4.1 Store cleared sample in fresh dibenzyl ether (DBE) in a light-tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging.
4.2 For imaging, mount sample in DBE within an appropriate imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hu C/D / PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 488, TH + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its proven efficacy in clearing thick, dense organs like the stomach, enabling deep antibody penetration and excellent 3D imaging. Its methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps are crucial for reducing autofluorescence (a major issue with gut tissue) and enhancing antibody access to neural antigens within the full-thickness gastric wall. The protocol's structured permeabilization and blocking steps directly address the user's previous problem of weak signal and high background. The chosen markers—PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal) and TH (catecholaminergic, labels a subset of vagal efferents and sympathetic fibers for contrast)—allow comprehensive mapping of neural architecture and sub-populations. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for anatomical orientation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Permeabilization, Blocking, and Immunostaining
1.1 Wash fixed stomach sample 3 times in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-T), 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.2 Incubation in permeabilization/blocking solution: PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3M Glycine, 20% DMSO, and 5% Normal Donkey Serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)
1.3 Primary antibody incubation: Incubate in PBS-T with 0.2% Tween-20, 10% DMSO, 6% Normal Donkey Serum, Heparin (10 µg/mL), and primary antibodies (e.g., rabbit anti-PGP9.5 1:500, sheep anti-TH 1:500).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.4 Wash sample 5 times in PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 (PBS-Tw), 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
1.5 Secondary antibody & nuclear stain incubation: Incubate in PBS-Tw with 10% DMSO, 6% Normal Donkey Serum, Heparin (10 µg/mL), donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), donkey anti-sheep Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and DAPI (2 µg/mL).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.6 Wash sample 5 times in PBS-Tw, 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Gradual dehydration in methanol/water series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol (vol/vol in dH2O), 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
2.2 Incubation in 100% methanol, overnight.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.3 Incubation in 66% Dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol (vol/vol), 3 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.4 Incubation in 100% DCM, 15 minutes, twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation in 100% Dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI~1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: Until sample is fully cleared, typically 12-24 hours)

4  Storage and Imaging
4.1 Store cleared sample in fresh 100% DBE in a light-tight container at RT until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)
4.2 For imaging, mount sample in DBE within an appropriate imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

DAPI is added for nuclear counterstaining to provide anatomical context. This combination allows for simultaneous, high-contrast visualization of the two neuronal populations and their projections without the need for antibody amplification, aligning perfectly with the goal of comparing their pathways.

1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM, Sigma 270997) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat once)

2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeat until tissue is fully transparent)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP (内源), tdTomato (内源), MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it provides excellent transparency for whole adult mouse brains (compatible with ~10 mm samples), strongly preserves endogenous fluorescence of EGFP and tdTomato (critical for long-range projection tracing), and achieves high refractive index (RI ~1.56) suitable for high-resolution light-sheet microscopy. The protocol includes a step for immunolabeling of MAP2 to visualize dendritic arbors, which complements the endogenous signals. The organic solvent-based process is relatively fast and maintains structural integrity for connectomic analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunolabeling for Dendritic Marker (Optional, if endogenous signal insufficient for fine dendrites)
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, each step.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated three times)
2.3 Blocking with PBS-T containing 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.02% sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody (chicken anti-MAP2, 1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.5 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated six times)
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody (donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.7 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated six times)
2.8 Dehydration through graded methanol series: 30%, 50%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS, each step.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
2.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)

3  Final Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.3 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) for final clearing and RI matching (RI ~1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)

4  Storage and Imaging
4.1 Store cleared brain in fresh DBE in a light-tight container at RT until imaging.(Temperature: RT)
4.2 For imaging, mount sample in DBE within an appropriate chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP (内源), tdTomato (内源), NeuN (RBFOX3)+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing depth and high transparency for whole mouse brains (~10 mm scale), strong preservation of endogenous fluorescent proteins (EGFP/tdTomato), and compatibility with immunolabeling for neuronal nuclei (NeuN) to provide a pan-neuronal structural reference. The method uses organic solvent-based dehydration and delipidation, which is relatively fast and yields a stable, shrunken sample suitable for high-resolution light-sheet microscopy to trace long-range projections and map terminal arborizations relative to neuronal somata.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)

2  Immunolabeling (Optional, for NeuN reference)
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, each step 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-Tx).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated three times)
2.3 Blocking with 5% (wt/vol) bovine serum albumin (BSA) in PBS-Tx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody anti-NeuN (Rabbit monoclonal, 1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.5 Wash with PBS-Tx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated four times)
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.7 Wash with PBS-Tx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated four times)

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Dehydration through graded methanol series: 30%, 50%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, each step 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
3.3 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)
3.5 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) for refractive index matching.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, until fully transparent)

4  Storage and Imaging
4.1 Store cleared brain in fresh DBE in a light-tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: long-term)
4.2 Mount sample in DBE for light-sheet microscopy imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 脱水与脱脂  
1.1 将固定后的小鼠全脑依次浸入30%、50%、70%、80%、100%、100% (vol/vol) 四氢呋喃（THF）水溶液中，每步置于摇床上温和振荡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 各12小时)  
1.2 将样本转移至100% (vol/vol) 二苄醚（DBE）中，静置浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时)  

2 折射率匹配与透明化  
2.1 将样本从DBE转移至折射率匹配液：88% (vol/vol) 二苄醚与12% (vol/vol) 四氢呋喃的混合液（RI ≈ 1.48）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时)  
2.2 更换为新鲜的相同折射率匹配液，继续浸泡直至组织完全透明（通常需额外24-48小时）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48小时)  

3 免疫标记（如需要增强树突骨架信号）  
*注：此步骤应在脱水步骤（1.1）之前进行，针对完整脑进行整体免疫标记。*  
3.1 样本经PBS充分洗涤后，浸入通透/封闭液：0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清，1% (wt/vol) BSA的PBS溶液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时)

3.5 重复步骤3.3进行洗涤。  
3.6 可选核染色：将样本浸入DAPI溶液（1 µg/mL in PBS）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos (primary) + Alexa Fluor 647 (secondary), NeuN (primary) + Alexa Fluor 488 (secondary), DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency for large, dense tissues (whole mouse brain and tongue) with minimal shrinkage, excellent preservation of endogenous and antibody-induced fluorescence, and compatibility with lipophilic dyes. Its organic-solvent-based approach efficiently clears lipids while maintaining structural integrity and fluorescent signals over months, which is critical for long-term imaging and 3D reconstruction of the tongue-brain circuit. The labeling strategy uses c-Fos as the activity-dependent marker for neurons activated during the anesthesia-wake transition, NeuN for pan-neuronal reference to contextualize c-Fos+ cells, and DAPI for nuclear counterstain and anatomical registration. Alexa Fluor dyes are chosen for their brightness and photostability in cleared tissue.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  Sample Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Wash fixed brain and tongue samples in PBS, 3 times, 30 min each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Wash in PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 (PBST), 3 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  

2  Immunostaining  
2.1 Blocking in blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% donkey serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-c-Fos (1:500), mouse anti-NeuN (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.3 Wash in PBST, 6 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 Wash in PBST, 6 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.7 Wash in PBS, 3 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  

3  Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol, 2 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4  Delipidation and Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM, 2 times, 15 min each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)  

5  Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI ~1.56) until samples are fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours)  

6  Storage and Imaging  
6.1 Store cleared samples in fresh DBE in light-tight vials at 4°C until imaging.  
6.2 For imaging, mount samples in DBE within an appropriate chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos (IEG1), Npas4 (IEG2), NeuN (neuronal marker), DAPI (nuclear counterstain)]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency for whole adult mouse brain (~1.5 cm) and tongue tissue while strongly preserving endogenous fluorescence and antibody-derived signals over months, which is critical for multi-target IEG detection. Its organic-solvent-based delipidation and final RI matching with DBE (RI~1.56) enable deep, high-resolution light-sheet imaging of whole organs. The labeling strategy uses two different immediate-early gene (IEG) antibodies (c-Fos and Npas4) to distinguish single- and double-positive activated neurons across brain regions (MTN, LC, PVT, NAcSh, etc.), combined with NeuN for neuronal identification and DAPI for whole-brain registration and cell counting.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  **Sample Preparation & Permeabilization**  
1.1 Wash fixed brain and tongue in PBS with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) for 6 hours, refreshing solution every 2 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with permeabilization solution: 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 2.3% (wt/vol) glycine in PBST. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Blocking with blocking solution: 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBST. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

2  **Immunolabeling**  
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in blocking solution: rabbit anti-c-Fos (1:500), goat anti-Npas4 (1:300), mouse anti-NeuN (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.2 Wash with PBST, refreshing solution every 8 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in blocking solution: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500), donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.4 Wash with PBST, refreshing solution every 8 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with nuclear counterstain: 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.6 Final wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

3  **Dehydration & Delipidation**  
3.1 Gradual dehydration in methanol/water series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in water, each step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours per step)  
3.2 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM), 33% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)  

4  **Refractive Index Matching & Clearing**  
4.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution: 85.6% (vol/vol) DBE (dibenzyl ether), 14.4% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Transfer to pure DBE (RI ~1.56) for final storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos (primary) + Alexa Fluor 488, Npas4 (primary) + Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its proven effectiveness in clearing whole adult mouse brains and large soft tissues (like tongue), excellent antibody penetration for deep structures (MTN, LC, PVT, NAcSh), and strong preservation of Alexa Fluor signals through methanol dehydration and dibenzyl ether (DBE) RI matching. The protocol includes critical steps (gradient dehydration/rehydration, permeabilization, blocking, long antibody incubations, and washes) that were missing in the failed attempt, ensuring high signal-to-noise ratio for dual immediate early gene (IEG) detection and vascular labeling. Methanol and DBE steps are carefully controlled to minimize antigen damage and tissue shrinkage.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  **Sample Preparation & Permeabilization**
    1.1 Wash fixed brain and tongue samples in PBS with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBTx) for 6 hours, refreshing solution every 2 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
    1.2 Incubation with permeabilization solution (PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
    1.3 Wash in PBTx for 6 hours, refreshing solution every 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

2  **Blocking**
    2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (wt/vol) Donkey Serum) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

3  **Primary Antibody Incubation**
    3.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in PBTx with 5% (wt/vol) BSA, 3% (vol/vol) DMSO, and 0.02% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide. Cocktail: rabbit anti-c-Fos (1:500), goat anti-Npas4 (1:300), IB4 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 555 conjugate (1:200). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
    3.2 Wash in PBTx for 24 hours, refreshing solution every 8 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4  **Secondary Antibody & Nuclear Stain Incubation**
    4.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in PBTx with 3% (vol/vol) DMSO. Cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
    4.2 Wash in PBTx for 24 hours, refreshing solution every 8 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
    4.3 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBTx for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
    4.4 Wash in PBS for 12 hours, refreshing solution every 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5  **Gradient Dehydration**
    5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    5.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6  **Delipidation & Bleaching**
    6.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
    6.2 Wash in 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

7  **Refractive Index Matching & Clearing**
    7.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
    7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
    7.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, then store in fresh DBE)

8  **Storage & Imaging**
    8.1 Store cleared samples in fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in light-tight vials. (Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)
    8.2 For imaging, mount sample in DBE within an appropriate chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method that achieves high transparency and strong tissue shrinkage (preserving sample architecture while reducing size), which is advantageous for imaging larger samples like the intact spinal cord (3 cm) and combined thalamic/cortical blocks. It preserves lipophilic dye fluorescence (DiI/DiD) exceptionally well and is compatible with long-term storage. Since the goal is to trace two distinct sensory projections using lipophilic tracers (DiI and DiD), no additional antibody labeling is required; uDISCO will maintain the bright, stable signals of these carbocyanine dyes throughout clearing and imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing  
2.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG) containing 0.4% (wt/vol) vitamin E (α-tocopherol) as antioxidant.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 Refresh with fresh DBE/vitamin E solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  

3  Storage and Imaging Preparation  
3.1 Store cleared samples in DBE/vitamin E solution in airtight glass vials, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: long-term)  
3.2 Mount samples in fresh DBE/vitamin E solution in appropriate imaging chambers for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

1  Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Post-fixation and dehydration in graded methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour each)

2.1 Incubation with Dibenzyl ether (DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

1.1 梯度脱水：将固定后的 scWAT 组织块依次浸入 30%、50%、70%、80%、96%、100% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液，每步 1 小时。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 每步 1 小时)
1.2 完全脱水：更换两次新鲜 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 1 小时)
1.3 通透：将组织浸入含 5% (vol/vol) 二甲基亚砜 (DMSO) 和 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的甲醇溶液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 过夜)

2 免疫标记
2.1 封闭：将组织浸入含 5% (vol/vol) DMSO 和 3% (wt/vol) 驴血清的甲醇溶液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 小时)
2.2 一抗孵育：将组织浸入含 5% (vol/vol) DMSO、3% (wt/vol) 驴血清、0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的甲醇溶液，并加入以下一抗混合物：兔抗-PGP9.5 (1:500)、兔抗-CGRP (1:300)、凝集素 IB4 (直接偶联 Alexa Fluor 488, 1:100)。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 小时)
2.3 洗涤：用含 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的甲醇溶液洗涤组织，共 6 次，每次 1 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 总计 6 小时)
2.4 二抗孵育：将组织浸入含 5% (vol/vol) DMSO、3% (wt/vol) 驴血清、0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的甲醇溶液，并加入以下二抗混合物：驴抗-兔 Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500)、驴抗-兔 Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500)。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 小时)
2.5 洗涤：用含 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的甲醇溶液洗涤组织，共 6 次，每次 1 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 总计 6 小时)
2.6 核染色：将组织浸入含 1 µg/mL DAPI 的甲醇溶液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 小时)

3 透明化与折射率匹配
3.1 梯度复水：将组织依次浸入 80%、60%、40%、20% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液，每步 1 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步 1 小时)
3.2 水化洗涤：用 PBS 洗涤组织两次，每次 1 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 总计 2 小时)
3.3 四氢呋喃 (THF) 脱水：将组织依次浸入 30%、50%、70%、80%、100% (vol/vol) THF 水溶液，每步 1 小时，然后更换两次新鲜 100% THF。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步 1 小时，100% THF 每次 1 小时)
3.4 二苄醚 (DBE) 透明：将组织浸入 100% (vol/vol) 二苄醚 (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG)。(Temperature: RT, Time: 直至组织完全透明，通常 3-6 小时，可过夜保存)

4.1 折射率检查与平衡：将透明组织置于新鲜 DBE 中，确保无浑浊。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 小时)
4.2 装样：将组织转移至充满 DBE 的专用成像皿或玻璃腔中，避免气泡，准备进行光片显微镜成像。

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP (primary + Alexa Fluor 488), PGP9.5 (primary + Alexa Fluor 647), Lectin (Alexa Fluor 594), DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency and significant tissue shrinkage (up to ~65% in volume), which is advantageous for imaging larger tissue blocks (1 cm³) and improves resolution. It preserves fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes well over time. The method is compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling and efficiently removes lipids, crucial for adipose tissue. CGRP marks specific sensory fibers, PGP9.5 labels the entire pan-neuronal network, Lectin outlines vasculature as a spatial reference, and DAPI provides nuclear architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Whole-Mount Immunolabeling (Post-Fixation)
1.1 Wash fixed scWAT block in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 6 hours, changing solution every 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Block and permeabilize in PBST containing 5% normal donkey serum and 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubate with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-CGRP (1:500) and chicken anti-PGP9.5 (1:1000) in PBST with 3% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.4 Wash in PBST for 24 hours, changing solution every 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.5 Incubate with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), plus Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated Lectin (1:200) and DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBST with 3% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.6 Wash in PBST for 24 hours, changing solution every 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

2  Dehydration
2.1 Incubation in 30% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation in 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation in fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3  Delipidation and Clearing
3.1 Incubation in 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.3 Incubation in fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

4  Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation in dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG) without shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.2 Transfer to fresh DBE for storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: >12 hours until fully transparent)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP+Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 594, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional clearing of large, lipid-rich tissues like subcutaneous white adipose tissue (scWAT), achieving high transparency and minimal tissue shrinkage. It is highly compatible with antibody staining and preserves a wide range of fluorophores (e.g., Alexa Fluor series). The protocol's organic solvent-based delipidation is efficient for fat, and the final refractive index (RI ~1.56) is ideal for high-resolution 3D imaging (e.g., light-sheet microscopy). The chosen labeling strategy uses CGRP for specific sensory nerve fibers, PGP9.5 as a pan-neuronal marker, and Lectin for vascular lumen labeling, enabling the precise spatial co-analysis required by the scientific goal.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining
2.1 Rehydration through a graded methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per step)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated three times)
2.3 Blocking and permeabilization in PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 3% (wt/vol) BSA, and 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Primary antibody incubation in blocking solution: rabbit anti-CGRP (1:500), chicken anti-PGP9.5 (1:1000), and DyLight 649-conjugated Lectin (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum*, 1:200).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.5 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeated six times over 12 hours)
2.6 Secondary antibody and nuclear stain incubation in blocking solution: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 594 (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.7 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeated six times over 12 hours)

3  Final Dehydration and Delipidation
3.1 Dehydration through a graded methanol series in PBS: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated once)
3.3 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)

4  Refractive Index Matching and Storage
4.1 Incubation with Dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.2 Transfer to fresh DBE for storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Overnight or until fully transparent)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647, CGRP+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is specifically designed for high-lipid tissues and provides exceptional delipidation and transparency for large samples like scWAT blocks. It preserves fluorescence from Alexa Fluor dyes exceptionally well, enabling deep imaging. The method uses tetrahydrofuran (THF) and dibenzyl ether (DBE) for aggressive lipid removal and high refractive index matching (RI ~1.56), which is crucial for imaging dense, light-scattering adipose tissue. This directly addresses the failure of the aqueous CUBIC method. The chosen markers—PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal) and CGRP (sensory nerve fibers)—are standard and compatible with uDISCO's harsh clearing process when conjugated to robust fluorophores like Alexa Fluor 488/647. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Immunostaining (Post-Fixation)
1.1 Wash fixed scWAT tissue block (1 cm × 1 cm × 0.5 cm) in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 6 hours, changing solution every 2 hours.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Blocking and permeabilization in PBST containing 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Primary antibody incubation in blocking solution containing rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and goat anti-CGRP (1:300).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.4 Wash in PBST for 24 hours, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.5 Secondary antibody incubation in blocking solution containing donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.6 Wash in PBST for 24 hours, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.7 Nuclear staining with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.8 Final wash in PBST for 12 hours.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Gradual dehydration in aqueous methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour per step)
2.2 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.3 Delipidation in 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.4 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation in 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, or until tissue is fully transparent)
3.2 Storage and imaging in fresh 100% DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647, Osteocalcin+Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional ability to clear dense, mineralized tissues like bone while preserving endogenous fluorescence and antibody labeling. It achieves high transparency through dehydration, delipidation, and refractive index matching, which is crucial for visualizing structures within the calcified bone matrix. The chosen labeling strategy targets key structures: PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker) for nerve fibers, Osteocalcin for bone matrix to delineate structure, Lectin for vasculature (a common path for nerves), and DAPI for nuclei. This combination allows for the specific identification of neural pathways (PGP9.5) within the context of bone (Osteocalcin) and vascular channels (Lectin).

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Decalcification and Decolorization (Critical for Bone)
2.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA, pH 8.0.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48-72 hours with gentle agitation, solution changed daily)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 3 times)

3  Immunofluorescence and Nuclear Staining
3.1 Blocking and permeabilization with PBST containing 10% normal goat serum and 0.5% Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500), goat anti-Osteocalcin (1:200), and biotinylated Lectin (e.g., Griffonia Simplicifolia Lectin I, 1:100) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle agitation)
3.3 Wash with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 6 times over 12 hours)
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), and Streptavidin Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle agitation)
3.5 Wash with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 6 times over 12 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.7 Wash with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes, repeated 3 times)

4  Final Dehydration and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)
4.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
4.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours until tissue is transparent)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 (泛神经标记) + Alexa Fluor 647, CGRP + Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin (凝集素) + Alexa Fluor 555, Hoechst]  
**Justification:** uDISCO 对矿化骨组织（如颅骨、股骨）和软组织（脑膜、骨髓）均有良好的整体透明效果，能保持组织形态并实现高折射率匹配（RI ~1.56），适合厚样本（如1.5 cm股骨）的深层成像。其有机溶剂流程能有效去除脂质并保留荧光信号，兼容抗体标记（经预处理后）和小分子染料。选择 PGP9.5 作为泛神经标记（覆盖所有神经纤维），CGRP 特异性标记感觉神经，Lectin 标记血管内皮以辅助定位骨髓腔和骨孔区域，Hoechst 标记细胞核以识别结构层次。

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 样本预处理与透化  
1.1 洗涤固定后样本：在 PBS 中洗涤 3 次，每次 1 小时，以去除残留固定剂。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours)  
1.2 透化：将样本置于 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的 PBS 溶液中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

2 免疫标记  
2.1 封闭：在含 5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清和 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 一抗孵育：在含 2% 血清的 PBS 中加入以下一抗混合物：兔抗 PGP9.5 (1:500)，兔抗 CGRP (1:300)，生物素化 Lectin (Griffonia simplicifolia, 1:200)。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.3 洗涤：用含 0.1% Triton X-100 的 PBS 洗涤 5 次，每次 2 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours)  
2.4 二抗与染料孵育：在含 2% 血清的 PBS 中加入以下混合物：驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500，对应 PGP9.5)，驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500，对应 CGRP)，链霉亲和素 Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500)，Hoechst 33342 (1:1000)。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 洗涤：用含 0.1% Triton X-100 的 PBS 洗涤 5 次，每次 2 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours)  

3 脱水  
3.1 梯度脱水：依次在 30%、50%、70%、80%、90%、96%、100% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中孵育，每级 2 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 14 hours)  
3.2 最终脱水：在 100% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇中孵育两次，每次 3 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

4 透明化与折射率匹配  
4.1 透明化：将样本转移至 uDISCO 基础溶液（含 25% (wt/vol) 尿素和 25% (wt/vol) 山梨醇的四氢呋喃溶液）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 折射率匹配：将样本转移至 uDISCO 储存液（四氢呋喃与二苄醚的混合液，体积比 1:2，RI ≈ 1.56）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 保存与成像前处理  
5.1 储存：将透明样本置于新鲜 uDISCO 储存液中，密封避光保存于 4 ℃。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期)  
5.2 成像前准备：将样本转移至定制成像皿，浸没于 uDISCO 储存液，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency in dense, mineralized tissues (including bone) while strongly preserving endogenous and antibody-induced fluorescence over long periods. The protocol includes a gentle EDTA decalcification step prior to clearing, which is critical for calcium-rich bone samples. The labeling strategy uses CGRP antibody to specifically label sensory nerve fibers, IB4-lectin to outline vascular channels (as a structural reference), and DAPI for nuclear architecture. This combination allows simultaneous 3D mapping of nerves, vessels, and bone marrow spaces.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  Decalcification and Pre‑treatment  
1.1 Incubation in 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) with gentle agitation. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7–10 days, solution changed daily)  
1.2 Wash in PBS (0.1 M, pH 7.4) 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

2  Immunostaining (Whole‑mount)  
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X‑100, 10% DMSO, 6% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti‑CGRP (1:500) and biotinylated IB4 (1:200) in PBS with 0.2% Triton X‑100, 3% donkey serum, 10 µM EDTA. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
2.3 Wash in PBS with 0.2% Tween‑20 (PBST) 6 × 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and streptavidin Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in PBST with 3% donkey serum. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 days)  
2.5 Wash in PBST 6 × 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  
2.6 Nuclear staining with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.7 Final wash in PBS 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

3.1 Incubation in 30% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation in 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.1 Incubation in 10% (wt/vol) EDTA (pH 7.4) in PBS with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7-14 days, solution changed every 2-3 days)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH (Tyrosine Hydroxylase) + Alexa Fluor 647, NPY + Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 555, Hoechst]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency in dense, mineralized bone tissues (including skull, femur, and tibia) while strongly preserving and even enhancing endogenous and antibody-derived fluorescence through its dehydration and organic-solvent-based clearing process. This method is particularly effective for whole-bone clearing and deep imaging of bone marrow cavities. The labeling strategy directly targets the scientific goal: TH labels noradrenergic sympathetic nerve fibers (tyrosine hydroxylase is the rate-limiting enzyme for norepinephrine synthesis), NPY labels peptidergic sympathetic fibers, IB4-lectin outlines vasculature as a structural reference, and Hoechst stains nuclei to define cellular regions. Alexa Fluor dyes are chosen for their brightness and stability in organic solvents.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  **Sample Preparation and Decalcification (Post-Fixation)**
1.1 Incubation in 10% EDTA (pH 7.4) with gentle agitation for decalcification. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7-10 days, solution changed daily)
1.2 Rinse in PBS 3 times to remove EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes per wash)

2  **Permeabilization and Blocking**
2.1 Incubation in permeabilization/blocking solution: PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

3  **Primary Antibody Staining**
3.1 Incubation in primary antibody cocktail: Rabbit anti-TH (1:500), Sheep anti-NPY (1:300), and IB4-Biotin (1:200) in PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20, 5% DMSO, and 3% normal donkey serum (PTwH). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

4  **Wash**
4.1 Rinse in PTwH 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
4.2 Incubation in fresh PTwH with gentle agitation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5  **Secondary Antibody and Dye Staining**
5.1 Incubation in secondary antibody and dye cocktail: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Donkey anti-Sheep Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Streptavidin Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500), and Hoechst 33342 (1:1000) in PTwH. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

6  **Wash**
6.1 Rinse in PTwH 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
6.2 Incubation in fresh PTwH with gentle agitation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

7  **Dehydration**
7.1 Incubation in a graded methanol series in distilled water: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
7.2 Incubation in fresh 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeated once)

8  **uDISCO Clearing and Refractive Index Matching**
8.1 Incubation in clearing solution: Diphenyl ether (DPE) containing 25% (vol/vol) Benzyl Benzoate and 0.4% (vol/vol) Vitamin E. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours, until fully transparent)
8.2 Transfer cleared sample to fresh clearing solution for storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Labeling:** [TH (酪氨酸羟化酶)+Alexa Fluor 647, NPY+Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin (凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 555, Hoechst]  
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for clearing dense, mineralized bone tissues (e.g., femur, tibia, skull) while preserving endogenous fluorescence and antibody labeling. It effectively decalcifies and delipidates in a single process, maintaining tissue integrity and antigenicity for multiplexed imaging of neural markers. The chosen labeling strategy uses TH (catecholaminergic marker) and NPY (peptidergic marker) to specifically identify sympathetic nerve subtypes. Lectin outlines vasculature, and Hoechst provides nuclear reference for spatial analysis of nerve-vessel-cell distances. Alexa Fluor dyes are bright and photostable for deep-tissue imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Decalcification and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with BoneClear solution A (4% EDTA, 0.5% Triton X-100, pH 7.4) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Replacement with fresh BoneClear solution A. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) three times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

2  Immunostaining and Dye Labeling
2.1 Blocking and permeabilization with 5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-TH (1:500), goat anti-NPY (1:300), biotinylated Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon Esculentum, 10 µg/mL) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST six times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), streptavidin Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500), and Hoechst 33342 (1:1000) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Wash with PBST six times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Dehydration in a graded methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol in distilled water, each step with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours per step)
3.2 Incubation with BoneClear solution B (40% w/v N‑methylacetamide, 60% w/v Histodenz in methanol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.3 Incubation with BoneClear solution C (40% w/v N‑methylacetamide, 60% w/v Histodenz in distilled water, RI ≈ 1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Transfer to fresh BoneClear solution C for final storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary, NPY primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 488 secondary, Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional ability to render hard, mineralized tissues like bone transparent while preserving endogenous fluorescence and antibody signals. It achieves high transparency and a high refractive index (RI ~1.56), which is crucial for imaging dense, light-scattering bone and marrow structures. The chosen labeling strategy directly addresses the scientific goals: TH and NPY antibodies specifically label sympathetic/peptidergic nerve fibers; IB4 lectin labels vascular endothelial cells, providing the vascular reference channel; and DAPI labels nuclei to visualize cellular density and bone marrow architecture. This combination allows for precise 3D co-localization analysis of nerves, vessels, and the hematopoietic niche.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Decalcification
1.1 Post-fixation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (PB).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Washing with 0.1 M PB (3 times).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
1.3 Decalcification with 10% Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) in 0.1 M PB, pH 7.4.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 14 days, with solution changed every 2 days)
1.4 Washing with 0.1 M PB (3 times).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

2  Immunostaining and Vascular Labeling
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking with PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% normal donkey serum, and 1% bovine serum albumin (BSA).(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-Tyrosine Hydroxylase (TH, 1:500), chicken anti-Neuropeptide Y (NPY, 1:300), and biotinylated Isolectin B4 (IB4, 1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Washing with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBS-T) (5 times).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody and streptavidin cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), and streptavidin Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Washing with PBS-T (5 times).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)
2.6 Nuclear staining with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Washing with PBS (3 times).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

3  Dehydration and Lipid Removal
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (twice).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours each)
3.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (twice).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each)

4  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Transfer to fresh DBE for storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH+Alexa Fluor 647, NPY+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS (Polyethylene glycol (PEG)-Associated Solvent System) is explicitly designed for hard, mineralized tissues like bone. It effectively combines decalcification, delipidation, and decolorization in a single, integrated protocol, which is critical for preserving the delicate architecture of the bone marrow cavity and the antigenicity of neural markers (TH, NPY). It uses tert-butanol for dehydration and clearing, which is highly compatible with mineralized tissues and provides excellent refractive index matching. This method is superior to SWITCH for dense bone, as it directly addresses the mineral barrier that likely prevented antibody penetration and clearing in your previous attempt.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Decalcification and Dehydration
1.1 Incubation in 20% (wt/vol) EDTA (pH 7.4) solution with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7-10 days, with solution change every 2 days)
1.2 Wash in 0.01 M PBS (pH 7.4) three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
1.3 Dehydration in a graded tert-butanol (tB) series: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 96%, 100% (vol/vol in ddH2O).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per step)
1.4 Final dehydration in fresh 100% tert-butanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2  Delipidation and Bleaching
2.1 Incubation in Benzyl Alcohol / Benzyl Benzoate (BABB) mixture (1:2 vol/vol) with 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 added.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48-72 hours, protected from light)
2.2 Wash in fresh BABB (1:2) without H2O2 twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

3  Rehydration and Permeabilization for Immunostaining
3.1 Rehydration in a reverse graded tert-butanol series: 100%, 90%, 80%, 70%, 50%, 30% (vol/vol in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per step)
3.2 Wash in PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
3.3 Blocking and permeabilization in PBST containing 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

4  Immunostaining
4.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: Rabbit anti-Tyrosine Hydroxylase (TH) and Rabbit anti-Neuropeptide Y (NPY) in blocking solution. Use species-specific, validated antibodies.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7-10 days with gentle shaking)
4.2 Wash in PBST six times over 48 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 8 hours per wash)
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (for TH) and Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (for NPY) in blocking solution. Use high-quality, pre-adsorbed antibodies at 1:500 dilution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7-10 days with gentle shaking)
4.4 Wash in PBST six times over 48 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 8 hours per wash)
4.5 Nuclear counterstaining with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.6 Final wash in PBS three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)

5  Final Dehydration and Refractive Index Matching
5.1 Dehydration in a graded tert-butanol series: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 96%, 100% (vol/vol in ddH2O).(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours per step)
5.2 Incubation in fresh 100% tert-butanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.3 Refractive Index matching by incubation in pure Benzyl Alcohol / Benzyl Benzoate (BABB) mixture (1:2 vol/vol, RI ~1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours until fully transparent)

1.2 深度脱水：在 100% (vol/vol) THF 中再次孵育过夜。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 小时)  

2 免疫标记（在脱水后进行，利用 THF 的通透性）  
2.1 再水化与封闭：将样本依次转移至 50% THF/PBS、20% THF/PBS、PBS，每步 1 小时；然后在含 0.2% Triton X-100、5% 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）、3% 驴血清的 PBS 中封闭。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步 1 小时，封闭 24 小时)  
2.2 一抗孵育：在含 0.2% Triton X-100、5% DMSO、3% 驴血清的 PBS 中，加入兔抗 PGP9.5（1:500）和小鼠抗 α-SMA（1:400）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 小时，温和摇动)

2.5 洗涤：用 PBST 洗涤 6 次，每次 2 小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 小时)

**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing of large, dense tissues (up to cm-scale), strong preservation of endogenous and antibody-derived fluorescence, and compatibility with whole-organ 3D imaging. The method uses tert-butanol and diphenyl ether for rapid dehydration and delipidation, achieving high transparency and refractive index matching (RI ~1.56) suitable for light-sheet microscopy. The labeling strategy combines PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker) for total nerve fibers, TH (tyrosine hydroxylase) for sympathetic-specific fibers, and Pan-Cytokeratin to delineate tumor epithelial boundaries. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for tissue architecture reference.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  **Dehydration & Delipidation**
    1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
    1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
    1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

2  **Immunolabeling (Pre-clearing)**
    2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, each for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)
    2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-T) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    2.3 Blocking with 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBS-T for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
    2.4 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500), sheep anti-TH (1:500), mouse anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:500) in blocking solution for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
    2.5 Wash with PBS-T, 6 changes over 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
    2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), donkey anti-sheep Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in blocking solution for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
    2.7 Wash with PBS-T, 6 changes over 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
    2.8 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
    2.9 Final wash with PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3  **Final Dehydration & Clearing**
    3.1 Dehydration through graded methanol series: 30%, 50%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS, each for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
    3.2 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
    3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

    3.5 Incubation with pure diphenyl ether (DPE, RI ~1.56) for refractive index matching and storage until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647, Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO provides excellent transparency and high shrinkage (ideal for the ~12x8x5 mm tumor block), superior preservation of endogenous fluorescence (crucial for potential reporter signals), and compatibility with lipophilic dyes and immunolabeling. The protocol is robust for dense, fibrous tissues like pancreas. PGP9.5 is a pan-neuronal marker to visualize the entire neural network. A broad-spectrum Cytokeratin antibody labels tumor epithelial cells. DAPI stains nuclei for spatial reference. This combination allows simultaneous 3D visualization of nerves, tumor epithelium, and nuclei to analyze spatial relationships.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunolabeling (Optional, if endogenous signal insufficient)
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series (100%, 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBST (0.2% Triton X-100)).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
2.2 Blocking and permeabilization in PBST containing 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
