2.4 Washing with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100).(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.6 Washing with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100).(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 1 hour)

2.8 Washing with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 x 1 hour)

2.10 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647 conjugate), CD31 (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate), Hoechst]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency and strong shrinkage (up to 65% in volume) in large, dense tissues like whole mouse brain tumors, enabling deep imaging of the entire 8 mm × 6 mm × 4 mm block with excellent preservation of endogenous and antibody-induced fluorescence. Its organic‑solvent‑based delipidation efficiently clears lipids while maintaining fluorescent protein signals, and the final refractive‑index‑matched solution (DBE) is ideal for high‑resolution light‑sheet microscopy. Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647) directly labels perfused vascular lumens, CD31 (Alexa Fluor 488) marks endothelial cells for structural analysis, and Hoechst provides nuclear counterstain to delineate tumor regions and necrosis.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2  Immunostaining and Lectin Labeling (performed after step 1.4)  
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, each step 1 hour at RT.  
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X‑100 (PBS‑T) 3 × 1 hour at RT.  
2.3 Blocking with 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBS‑T.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody rat anti‑mouse CD31 (1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.5 Wash with PBS‑T 6 × 1 hour at RT.  
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody donkey anti‑rat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647‑conjugated Lectin (Griffonia simplicifolia, 1:100) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.7 Wash with PBS‑T 6 × 1 hour at RT.  
2.8 Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (2 µg/mL) in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.9 Wash with PBS 3 × 1 hour at RT.  
2.10 Dehydration through graded methanol series: 30%, 50%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS, each step 1 hour at RT, then 100% methanol overnight at 4 ℃.  

3  Final Clearing and Refractive‑Index Matching  
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014‑1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeated once until tissue is fully transparent)  

4  Storage and Imaging  
4.1 Store cleared sample in fresh DBE in a light‑tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging.  
4.2 For imaging, mount sample in DBE‑filled chamber and acquire with light‑sheet or confocal microscope using appropriate filter sets for Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647 and Hoechst.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647 conjugate), CD31 (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate), Hoechst]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency and strong tissue shrinkage (preserving morphology while reducing sample size), which is advantageous for imaging a dense, heterogeneous glioblastoma sample (~8×6×4 mm). It preserves fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes well and is compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling. Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum lectin) injected intravitally binds to perfused vascular luminal surfaces, marking functional perfusion; CD31 labels endothelial cells for structural vasculature; Hoechst labels nuclei for spatial reference. This dual-channel strategy allows direct comparison of structural vs. perfused vessels.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)  

2  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing  
2.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) containing 0.4% (vol/vol) vitamin E (α-tocopherol) as antioxidant.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeated once)  
2.2 Storage in fresh DBE/vitamin E solution for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)  

3  Immunolabeling (Performed After Step 1.4, Before Step 1.5)  
3.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% methanol in PBS, each step 1 hour at RT.  
3.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-T) 3 × 1 hour at RT.  
3.3 Blocking with PBS-T containing 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.1% sodium azide.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
3.4 Incubation with primary antibody rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  
3.5 Wash with PBS-T 6 × 1 hour at RT.  
3.6 Incubation with secondary antibody donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Hoechst 33342 (1:1000) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  
3.7 Wash with PBS-T 6 × 1 hour at RT.  
3.8 Proceed to dehydration (Step 1.4) and subsequent clearing steps.  

**Note:** Functional perfusion labeling with Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647 must be performed *in vivo* via tail-vein injection (e.g., 100 µg in 100 µL PBS) 5–10 minutes before euthanasia and perfusion fixation. The fluorescent lectin signal will remain through the uDISCO processing.

Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647) labels perfused vessels by binding to endothelial glycocalyx, while CD31 (Alexa Fluor 488) labels all endothelial cells for total vascular architecture. DAPI provides nuclear context to distinguish tumor core, invasive margin, and normal brain regions.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  **Sample Preparation and Permeabilization**
    1.1 Wash fixed tissue block (8 mm × 6 mm × 4 mm) in PBS with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) for 6 hours at room temperature with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
    1.2 Incubate in permeabilization solution: 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2  **Immunolabeling and Lectin Staining**
    2.1 Blocking: Incubate in blocking solution: 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.05% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
    2.2 Primary antibody incubation: Incubate with anti-CD31 (PECAM1) antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking solution). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
    2.3 Wash: Wash tissue 6 times with PBST, 2 hours per wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)
    2.4 Secondary antibody and lectin incubation: Incubate with donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum, 20 µg/mL) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
    2.5 Wash: Wash tissue 6 times with PBST, 2 hours per wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)
    2.6 Nuclear staining: Incubate with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
    2.7 Final wash: Wash tissue 3 times with PBS, 2 hours per wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3  **Dehydration and Delipidation**
    3.1 Dehydration series: Incubate in graded tert-butanol (tBOH) solutions: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 96%, 100% (vol/vol) in distilled water, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 14 hours total)
    3.2 Delipidation: Incubate in 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

4  **Refractive Index Matching and Clearing**
    4.1 Incubation in benzyl benzoate/benzyl alcohol mixture (BB/BA, 2:1 vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
    4.2 Final clearing and storage: Transfer to pure benzyl benzoate (RI ~1.56) for imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, then store at 4 ℃ in the dark)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 488, Hoechst]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it provides excellent transparency for large, fixed tissues (like the 8×6×4 mm glioma sample), preserves endogenous and antibody-induced fluorescence well, and achieves high refractive index matching (RI ~1.56) for deep 3D imaging. Its organic-solvent-based protocol effectively removes lipids while maintaining structural integrity. The labeling strategy uses CD31 (PECAM1) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 to mark vascular endothelial structure, while Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 labels perfused vascular lumens (via intravenous perfusion before fixation). Hoechst is used for nuclear counterstain. This combination allows simultaneous visualization of endothelial architecture and functional perfusion, with minimal background, enabling quantitative analysis of density, branching, diameter, curvature, continuity, perfusion ratio, and core-vs.-edge heterogeneity.

**Protocol Steps:**

1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat once)  

2  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing  
2.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) containing 0.4% (vol/vol) Vitamin E (α-tocopherol) as antioxidant.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, repeat once until tissue is fully transparent)  

3  Immunostaining (Performed Before Clearing)  
3.1 Permeabilization and Blocking: Incubation with PTxw.2 solution (PBS with 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 0.05% wt/vol Tween-20, 0.1% wt/vol sodium azide, 20% vol/vol DMSO, 3% vol/vol normal donkey serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  
3.2 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with anti-CD31 antibody (Rat anti-mouse, 1:200 dilution) in PTxw.2 solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)  
3.3 Wash: Incubation with PTxw.2 solution (without serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, repeat 3 times)  
3.4 Secondary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with donkey anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500 dilution) and Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488 (20 µg/mL) in PTxw.2 solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)  
3.5 Wash: Incubation with PTxw.2 solution (without serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, repeat 3 times)  
3.6 Nuclear Staining: Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (1:1000 dilution) in PTxw.2 solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.7 Final Wash: Incubation with PTxw.2 solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, repeat twice)  

4  Post-Staining Dehydration (Before Step 1)  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)  

5  Storage and Imaging  
5.1 Store cleared sample in fresh DBE + 0.4% Vitamin E solution in a light-tight container at 4 ℃ until imaging.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (endogenous), Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 488]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its excellent clearing of whole mouse brains, strong preservation of endogenous tdTomato/RFP fluorescence, and compatibility with subsequent immunolabeling for epithelial markers. The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps effectively clear the tissue while maintaining fluorescent protein signals. The protocol is well-established for large tissues (~1 cm) and is compatible with light-sheet microscopy for 3D reconstruction of metastasis patterns. Adding an anti-Pan-Cytokeratin antibody (conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488) allows for independent validation of the epithelial identity of the tdTomato+ cells, distinguishing true metastatic foci from background autofluorescence.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunolabeling
2.1 Rehydration through a methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBTx) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)
2.3 Incubation with blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, and 3% (wt/vol) bovine serum albumin (BSA) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody: Rabbit anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.5 Wash with PBTx (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 6 times over 24 hours)
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody: Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)
2.7 Wash with PBTx (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 6 times over 24 hours)

3  Delipidation and Clearing
3.1 Dehydration through a methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)
3.3 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat once)

4  Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeat once until tissue is fully transparent and sinks)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato/RFP (内源), Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO 方法在保留 tdTomato/RFP 等内源荧光蛋白信号方面表现出色，这对于追踪转移灶至关重要。其脱水-脱脂-折射率匹配的流程能有效减少组织形变，维持结构完整性，适合进行精确的三维重建和边界分析。选择 Pan-Cytokeratin（上皮性肿瘤标志物）与 Alexa Fluor 647 偶联进行免疫标记，可在保留内源信号的同时，独立验证转移癌细胞的身份。DAPI 用于标记细胞核，清晰界定脑实质与转移灶的细胞构成，辅助识别微小转移细胞群和侵袭前沿。

**Protocol Steps:**
1 脱水与脱脂
1.1 梯度脱水：依次在 30%、50%、80%、96%、100% 的叔丁醇（t-butanol）水溶液（vol/vol）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步 12 小时)
1.2 脱脂：在二氯甲烷（Dichloromethane, DCM）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 小时)
1.3 最终脱水：在 100% 叔丁醇中再次孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 小时)

2 折射率匹配与透明化
2.1 浸入二苄醚（Dibenzyl ether, DBE）中进行折射率匹配。(Temperature: RT, Time: 直至组织沉底并透明，约 24-48 小时)

3 免疫标记（透明化前进行）
3.1 通透与封闭：将固定后组织在含 0.5% Triton X-100 和 5% 驴血清的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 72 小时)
3.2 一抗孵育：在含 0.2% Triton X-100、5% 驴血清和抗 Pan-Cytokeratin 抗体（1:200）的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 10 天)
3.3 洗涤：在含 0.2% Triton X-100 的 PBS 中洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每天更换洗液，共洗涤 3 天)
3.4 二抗孵育：在含 0.2% Triton X-100、5% 驴血清和驴抗小鼠 Alexa Fluor 647 二抗（1:500）的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 10 天)
3.5 洗涤与核染色：在含 0.2% Triton X-100 和 DAPI（1:1000）的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 72 小时)
3.6 最终洗涤：在 PBS 中洗涤以去除多余染料。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 小时，更换洗液 3 次)

4 透明化后保存与成像前处理
4.1 透明化后，将组织保存在新鲜 DBE 中，避光，4℃储存。
4.2 成像前，将组织转移至定制成像皿，并浸没在 DBE 中。

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP+Alexa Fluor 488, TH+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for mineralized bone tissue, combining decalcification, delipidation, and refractive index matching in a single integrated protocol. It preserves endogenous fluorescence and antibody epitopes well, and its aqueous‑based, detergent‑free chemistry is compatible with immunolabeling of hard‑tissue structures. The method achieves high transparency in intact mouse femurs (~15 mm) while maintaining structural integrity of delicate neural networks. Alexa Fluor conjugates provide bright, photostable signals for dual‑color imaging of CGRP+ (sensory) and TH+ (sympathetic) fibers, and DAPI labels nuclei for anatomical reference.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with BoneClear Decalcification Solution (10% EDTA, 0.5% Triton X‑100, pH 7.4) with gentle agitation. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween‑20 (PBST) three times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Blocking and permeabilization in blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X‑100, 0.01% sodium azide in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti‑CGRP (1:500) and mouse anti‑TH (1:1000) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST six times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti‑mouse Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Wash with PBST six times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)
2.6 Nuclear staining with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Final wash with PBST three times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

3 Delipidation and Clearing
3.1 Dehydration in graded methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol (each in deionized water), 2 hours per step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours total)
3.2 Delipidation in BoneClear Clearing Solution (33% (vol/vol) formamide, 33% (vol/vol) polyethylene glycol, 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween‑20). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.3 Rinse with BoneClear Rinsing Solution (50% (vol/vol) formamide, 50% (vol/vol) polyethylene glycol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Equilibration in BoneClear Mounting Medium (88% (vol/vol) Histodenz, 12% (vol/vol) polyethylene glycol, RI = 1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Mount the cleared femur in fresh BoneClear Mounting Medium in a glass‑bottom dish or chamber for imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: stable for months at 4 ℃)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Anti-CGRP antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, Anti-PGP9.5 antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin (IB4) conjugated to DyLight 550, Hoechst]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional clearing capability for dense, mineralized tissues like bone, achieving high transparency and significant sample shrinkage (beneficial for imaging large volumes). It preserves fluorescence of conjugated dyes like Alexa Fluor exceptionally well, which is crucial for the multiplexed labeling required. The chosen labeling strategy directly addresses the scientific goals: Alexa Fluor 647-anti-CGRP for specific peptidergic sensory fibers, Alexa Fluor 488-anti-PGP9.5 as a pan-neuronal marker to visualize the entire neural network, IB4-lectin to label vascular endothelium and some non-peptidergic fibers as a structural reference, and Hoechst for nuclear counterstain.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Sample Preparation and Decalcification
1.1 Post-fixation with 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 0.1 M PB (pH 7.4).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Decalcification with 10% (wt/vol) EDTA (pH 7.4) in 0.1 M PB with gentle agitation. Solution changed daily.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 14 days)
1.3 Wash with 0.1 M PB (pH 7.4) to remove EDTA.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with 3 buffer changes)

2  Immunostaining and Labeling
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking with PBS-T (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100) containing 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-CGRP (1:500) and chicken anti-PGP9.5 (1:1000) in PBS-T with 1% normal donkey serum and 0.1% gelatin.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with 6 buffer changes)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), along with IB4-lectin DyLight 550 (1:200) and Hoechst 33342 (1:1000) in PBS-T with 1% normal donkey serum and 0.1% gelatin.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Wash with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with 6 buffer changes)

3  Dehydration and Solvent Transition
3.1 Dehydration in a graded methanol series in PBS: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol, each step.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours per step)
3.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4  uDISCO Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.3 Incubation with Diethyl Ether (freshly opened, anhydrous).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with uDISCO final solution: Diphenyl Ether (DPE) with 0.5% (vol/vol) 2,2'-Thiodiethanol as antioxidant.(Temperature: RT, Time: Until sample is fully transparent, typically 24-48 hours)

5  Refractive Index Matching and Storage
5.1 Mounting and imaging in fresh uDISCO final solution (RI ~1.56). Sample can be stored in this solution at 4 ℃ in the dark for several months.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Anti-CGRP antibody + Alexa Fluor 647, Anti-TH antibody + Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D imaging of intact, mineralized mouse femur to map nerve-vascular spatial relationships. uDISCO is selected because it achieves exceptional tissue transparency and shrinkage (enabling imaging of larger samples), robustly preserves endogenous and antibody-induced fluorescence through its dehydration and organic solvent-based process, and is compatible with hard tissues like bone. The labeling strategy directly addresses the targets: Anti-CGRP for peptidergic sensory fibers, Anti-TH for sympathetic fibers, Lectin (IB4) for vascular endothelium and non-peptidergic sensory fibers (as an auxiliary vascular channel), and DAPI for cellular nuclei to delineate tissue architecture. This combination allows for multiplexed, correlative analysis of nerve subtypes relative to vascular and tumor boundaries.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining and Labeling
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 80%, 50%, 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.2 Washing with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 3 times)
2.3 Blocking and permeabilization with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, and 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in blocking solution: Rabbit anti-CGRP (1:500), Sheep anti-TH (1:500), Biotinylated IB4 Lectin (10 µg/mL).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle agitation)
2.5 Washing with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 6 times over 12 hours)
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody and streptavidin cocktail in blocking solution: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Donkey anti-Sheep Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Streptavidin Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle agitation)
2.7 Washing with PBS-T.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 6 times over 12 hours)
2.8 Nuclear staining with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.9 Final wash with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 3 times)

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Dehydration through graded methanol series: 30%, 50%, 80%, 100%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.4 Refractive index matching by incubation in dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours or until transparent)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (endogenous), Sox10+Alexa Fluor 647, Hoechst]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing of small, dense embryonic tissues (5 mm³), strong preservation of endogenous tdTomato fluorescence (critical for lineage tracing), and compatibility with immunolabeling. The method provides high transparency and a refractive index (~1.56) suitable for high-resolution deep imaging. The labeling strategy leverages the endogenous Wnt1-Cre;tdTomato signal for lineage mapping. Sox10, a key neural crest/glial lineage transcription factor, is targeted with a compatible Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated antibody to identify cell state. Hoechst is added for nuclear counterstaining to provide cellular context. This combination allows for direct co-localization analysis of lineage (tdTomato) and state (Sox10) signals in the target structures.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunolabeling
2.1 Blocking and permeabilization in PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, and 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Primary antibody incubation with rabbit anti-Sox10 antibody (1:200) and mouse anti-Sox10 antibody (1:200) in PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 5% (vol/vol) DMSO, and 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum (PBTD).(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 48 hours)
2.3 Wash in PBTD.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)
2.4 Secondary antibody and nuclear stain incubation with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Hoechst 33342 (1:1000) in PBTD.(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 48 hours)
2.5 Wash in PBTD.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 2 times)
3.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: until sample is fully cleared and sink, minimum 3 hours)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647 conjugate), IB4 (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate), DAPI]
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D reconstruction of the dense, blood-rich placental villous vascular tree. uDISCO is selected for its exceptional ability to render large, lipid-rich tissues (like the placenta) transparent while strongly preserving endogenous fluorescence and the signal of conjugated dyes like Alexa Fluor. Its organic solvent-based process effectively removes heme and lipids, which are major obstacles in placental clearing, minimizing background and scattering. The labeling strategy uses Lectin and IB4 to specifically bind to glycocalyx on the luminal surface of perfused fetal vasculature, allowing for functional channel mapping. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for structural context. This combination ensures clear visualization of vascular branches, capillaries, and the maternal-fetal interface.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Wash fixed placenta sample in 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4, with 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBTx).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal donkey serum in PBTx).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with primary labeling cocktail: Lectin (Griffonia Simplicifolia, Alexa Fluor 647 conjugate, 5 µg/mL) and IB4 (Isolectin GS-IB4, Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate, 10 µg/mL) in PBTx with 5% normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.4 Wash in PBTx.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours, with 3 solution changes)
1.5 Incubation with secondary nuclear stain: DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBTx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.6 Wash in 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, with 3 solution changes)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

3  uDISCO Clearing and RI Matching
3.1 Incubation with clearing solution: Diphenyl ether (DPE) with 0.5% (vol/vol) antioxidant (DBHQ).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours, until tissue is transparent)
3.2 Storage and imaging in fresh clearing solution (DPE with 0.5% DBHQ).(Temperature: RT, RI = ~1.56)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (IB4)+Alexa Fluor 647, CD31+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its excellent clearing of large, dense tissues (like the 10–12 mm placenta), strong fluorescence preservation for Alexa Fluor dyes, and compatibility with whole-mount immunolabeling. It achieves high transparency and high refractive index (RI ~1.56) suitable for high-resolution deep imaging. The labeling strategy uses IB4 lectin (a pan-endothelial marker that binds glycocalyx, injected in vivo to label perfused luminal surfaces) and anti-CD31 antibody (to label all endothelial structures, including non-perfused vessels), enabling direct comparison of perfused vs. structural vasculature. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for tissue architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  **Perfusion Labeling (Pre-fixation)**
1.1 In vivo perfusion of 100 µg/mL IB4-Alexa Fluor 647 in PBS via the maternal circulation (or direct umbilical artery injection if feasible) for 10 minutes. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 10 minutes)
1.2 Perfusion fixation with 4% PFA in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 20 minutes)

2  **Sample Preparation**
2.1 Post-fixation of dissected whole placenta in 4% PFA. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBS-Tx). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 x 1 hour)

3  **Immunolabeling**
3.1 Blocking with 5% normal donkey serum in PBS-Tx. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody: Rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:200) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.3 Wash with PBS-Tx. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Donkey anti-rat IgG-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.5 Wash with PBS-Tx. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 1 hour)

4  **Dehydration**
4.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 x 1 hour)

5  **Delipidation & Clearing**
5.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

6  **Refractive Index Matching**
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, until sample is transparent)

7  **Mounting & Imaging**
7.1 Transfer cleared placenta to a fresh DBE-filled imaging chamber. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate)
7.2 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate filter sets for DAPI, Alexa Fluor 488, and Alexa Fluor 647.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO 提供极强的脂质去除和脱水能力，非常适合富含血液和脂质的胎盘组织，能有效降低背景自发荧光。其使用四氢呋喃(THF)和苯甲醇二苄醚(DBE)的流程能彻底去除脂质并实现高折射率匹配，获得高度透明的样本，利于深层成像。标记策略上，凝集素(Lectin)能广泛标记血管内皮糖萼和腔面，CD31抗体特异性标记内皮细胞用于形态学重建，DAPI标记细胞核提供结构参考。Alexa Fluor染料光稳定性好，与uDISCO流程兼容。

**Protocol Steps:**
1 脱水与脱脂
1.1 孵育于30% (vol/vol) 四氢呋喃(THF)水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 孵育于50% (vol/vol) THF水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 孵育于70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 孵育于80% (vol/vol) THF水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 孵育于100% (vol/vol) THF中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12小时，重复一次)
1.6 孵育于100% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷(DCM)中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2小时)

2 免疫标记
2.1 重水化：将样本依次转移至100%、95%、80%、70%、50%、30% THF/PBS溶液，每步1小时。(Temperature: RT)
2.2 洗涤：于PBS中洗涤3次，每次1小时。(Temperature: RT)
2.3 通透与封闭：孵育于含0.2% Triton X-100, 5% 驴血清, 1% BSA的PBS中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 48小时)
2.4 一抗孵育：孵育于含抗小鼠CD31一抗(1:200)及凝集素(如UEA-I, 10 µg/mL)的封闭液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 96小时)
2.5 洗涤：于含0.1% Tween-20的PBS(PBST)中洗涤6次，每次2小时。(Temperature: RT)
2.6 二抗孵育：孵育于含驴抗大鼠Alexa Fluor 488(针对CD31)及链霉亲和素Alexa Fluor 647(针对凝集素)的封闭液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 96小时)
2.7 洗涤：于PBST中洗涤6次，每次2小时。(Temperature: RT)
2.8 核染色：孵育于含DAPI (1 µg/mL)的PBS中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24小时)
2.9 最终洗涤：于PBS中洗涤3次，每次2小时。(Temperature: RT)

3 再脱水与透明化
3.1 孵育于30% (vol/vol) THF水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12小时)
3.2 孵育于50% (vol/vol) THF水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12小时)
3.3 孵育于70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12小时)
3.4 孵育于80% (vol/vol) THF水溶液中。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12小时)
3.5 孵育于100% (vol/vol) THF中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12小时，重复两次)
3.6 孵育于100% (vol/vol) 二苄醚(DBE)中。(Temperature: RT, Time: 直至样本完全透明，约24-48小时)

4 折射率匹配与保存
4.1 将透明样本浸没于新鲜DBE中，置于避光密封容器。(Temperature: RT, Time: 长期保存)
4.2 成像前，将样本置于专用DBE浸泡的成像腔中进行光片显微镜或共聚焦显微镜三维成像。

The chosen markers directly address the scientific goal: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-Homer1 antibody specifically labels the postsynaptic scaffolding protein Homer1, marking excitatory postsynaptic densities. **Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1  Post-fixation and permeabilization: Incubation with 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.2  Blocking: Incubation with blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3  Primary antibody incubation: Incubation with chicken anti-Homer1 primary antibody (1:500) and biotinylated Concanavalin A Lectin (10 µg/mL) in antibody dilution buffer (1% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.4  Wash: Incubation with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with solution changed every 2 hours)
1.5  Secondary antibody and streptavidin incubation: Incubation with donkey anti-chicken IgG secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and streptavidin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.6  Wash: Incubation with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with solution changed every 2 hours)
1.7  Nuclear staining: Incubation with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.8  Final wash: Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2.1  Dehydration: Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2  Dehydration: Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3  Dehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4  Dehydration: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5  Delipidation: Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2.7  Delipidation: Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Alexa Fluor 647, Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional clearing depth and high transparency in thick tissues (1-2 mm), crucial for 3D reconstruction of CA1 sublayers. It preserves lipophilic dyes and fluorescent proteins well, but more importantly, it is highly compatible with antibody labeling after clearing (post-clearing immunolabeling), which is essential for targeting specific endogenous synaptic scaffold proteins. The chosen fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 647 & 555) offer bright, photostable signals for multiplexing and colocalization analysis. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for layer identification. This strategy allows for sequential labeling of two different primary antibodies against the target postsynaptic proteins, followed by clearing, enabling high-resolution 3D imaging of puncta distribution and spatial heterogeneity.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Fixation and Pre-processing
1.1 Perfusion with 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (PB), pH 7.4. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 10 minutes)
1.2 Post-fixation of dissected hippocampal tissue block in 4% PFA. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Washing with 0.1 M PB containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBTx). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 x 1 hour)
2  Immunolabeling (Post-clearing)
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution: 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBTx. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail (e.g., Mouse anti-PSD-95 and Rabbit anti-Homer1) diluted in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.3 Washing with PBTx. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail (Donkey anti-Mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 and Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555) diluted in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Washing with PBTx. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBTx for nuclear staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.7 Final wash with 0.1 M PB. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 x 1 hour)
3  Dehydration and Delipidation
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 x 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 x 15 minutes)
4  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: Until tissue is transparent, minimum 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Alexa Fluor 647, Alexa Fluor 488, Phalloidin]
**Justification:** uDISCO provides excellent transparency and high refractive index (RI ~1.56) for high-resolution imaging of thick tissue blocks (1-2 mm). It preserves fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes exceptionally well, which is crucial for long-term imaging and 3D reconstruction. The chosen labeling strategy uses Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated antibodies against PSD95 and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated antibodies against Homer1 for dual-color excitatory postsynaptic protein visualization. Phalloidin (conjugated to a far-red dye like Alexa Fluor 750, implied) is included as an auxiliary marker to outline dendritic actin cytoskeleton, aiding in distinguishing dendritic shafts and spines from background and providing structural context for puncta localization without interfering with the primary synaptic signals.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Post-fixation and permeabilization: Incubation with 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Blocking: Incubation with blocking solution containing 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Primary antibody incubation: Incubation with chicken anti-MAP2 (1:500), mouse anti-PSD95 (1:200), and rabbit anti-Homer1 (1:200) in antibody dilution buffer (1% serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
1.4 Wash: Three incubation cycles with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours per cycle)
1.5 Secondary antibody and phalloidin incubation: Incubation with donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 405 (1:500), donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), and Alexa Fluor 750-conjugated Phalloidin (1:100) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
1.6 Final wash: Three incubation cycles with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per cycle)

2  Dehydration and Lipids Removal
2.1 Dehydration: Serial incubation with 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 96%, and 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)
2.2 Delipidation: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 RI matching: Incubation with freshly prepared uDISCO solution (mixture of benzyl alcohol and benzyl benzoate in a 1:2 ratio).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Storage/Imaging: Mount the cleared tissue block in fresh uDISCO solution for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Synapsin, PSD-95, MAP2, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional ability to preserve endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP/YFP), achieve high transparency with minimal tissue deformation (critical for dendritic spine and puncta analysis), and provide excellent refractive index (RI) matching for high-resolution confocal imaging of 1-2 mm thick tissue blocks. The chosen labeling strategy uses antibodies against Synapsin (presynaptic) and PSD-95 (postsynaptic) to distinguish excitatory postsynaptic compartments, MAP2 to delineate dendritic architecture, and DAPI for nuclear counterstain. This combination allows for precise 3D mapping of synaptic protein distribution and spine density in CA1 with low background and high structural preservation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Post-fixation of 1-2 mm thick mouse hippocampal CA1 slices in 4% PFA in 0.1 M PB.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Permeabilization and blocking in PBS++ (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 0.02% sodium azide, 5% normal donkey serum).(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
1.3 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: chicken anti-MAP2 (1:1000), guinea pig anti-Synapsin 1/2 (1:500), rabbit anti-PSD-95 (1:500) in PBS++.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.4 Washing with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBS-T).(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 x 2 hours)
1.5 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), donkey anti-guinea pig Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500), donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS++.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cx40/Hcn4 (conduction system identity), Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647 (F-actin reference), DAPI (nuclear counterstain)]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it achieves high transparency in dense, vascularized tissues like the fixed mouse heart while strongly preserving endogenous fluorescence and antibody signals. Its organic-solvent-based dehydration and delipidation efficiently clear lipid-rich myocardium and blood vessels, and the final RI-matching step (DBE) provides excellent optical clarity for whole-organ 3D imaging (e.g., light-sheet microscopy). The protocol is relatively rapid (days vs. weeks) and maintains structural integrity for tracing continuous conduction pathways. The labeling strategy uses Cx40/Hcn4 (key conduction system markers) to specifically identify the sinoatrial node, atrioventricular node, His bundle, and Purkinje fibers; Phalloidin provides orientation reference for cardiomyocyte fibers; DAPI gives overall nuclear architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)  

2  Delipidation and Bleaching (optional, if autofluorescence is high)  
2.1 Incubation with fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3  Rehydration and Blocking  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)  
3.5 Incubation with blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

4  Immunostaining and Phalloidin/DAPI Labeling  
4.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail (e.g., rabbit anti-Cx40 1:200, goat anti-Hcn4 1:200 in blocking solution) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48–72 hours with gentle shaking)  
4.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-T) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 4 times)  
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail (e.g., donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 1:500, donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 555 1:500, Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647 1:100, DAPI 1:1000 in blocking solution) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48–72 hours with gentle shaking)  
4.4 Wash with PBS-T (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 4 times)  

5  Dehydration for Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)  

6  Solvent-Based Clearing and RI Matching  
6.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat once)  
6.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, then store in fresh DBE for imaging)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cntn2 (Primary Antibody), HCN4 (Primary Antibody), Alexa Fluor 647 (Secondary Antibody), Alexa Fluor 488 (Secondary Antibody), DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is chosen for its excellent clearing depth and tissue shrinkage (~45%), which is beneficial for reducing the physical size of the intact heart for easier imaging while preserving structural relationships. Its organic solvent-based process effectively removes lipids, significantly reducing myocardial autofluorescence. The method is compatible with antibody labeling prior to dehydration and clearing. Using Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 provides bright, photostable signals against the cleared background. DAPI is included for general nuclear counterstaining to aid in orientation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining
2.1 Blocking and Permeabilization: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 1% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum, and primary antibodies (e.g., rabbit anti-Cntn2 and goat anti-HCN4, dilutions as per manufacturer).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.3 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, repeat 3 times)
2.4 Secondary Antibody and DAPI Incubation: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 1% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum, species-appropriate Alexa Fluor 488/647 conjugated secondary antibodies (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Final Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, repeat 3 times)

3  Final Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat once)
3.4 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.6 Refractive Index Matching: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: Until tissue sinks, typically 12-24 hours)

1  **Sample Preparation & Permeabilization**
    1.1 Wash fixed colon sample in PBS with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBS-Tx) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
    1.2 Incubation with permeabilization solution (PBS with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 20% (vol/vol) DMSO) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647, HuC/D-Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5-Alexa Fluor 555]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional clearing depth and shrinkage control, which is critical for the long (6-8 cm), tubular colon sample to ensure uniform reagent penetration and minimal structural distortion. It preserves fluorescence well for conjugated antibodies and phalloidin. The labeling strategy uses Phalloidin-AF647 to delineate F-actin-rich muscle layers (circular/longitudinal) for structural context. HuC/D-AF488 (pan-neuronal) and PGP9.5-AF555 (general neuronal marker) provide complementary, robust labeling of enteric neuron somas and fibers in both myenteric and submucosal plexuses, enabling 3D co-localization analysis with the muscle and mucosal architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Sample Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Wash fixed colon sample in 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4, with 0.3% Triton X-100 (PBST) on a rocker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with blocking solution (5% normal donkey serum in PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: mouse anti-HuC/D (1:200) and rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.4 Wash sample in PBST on a rocker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with solution changed every 2 hours)
1.5 Incubation with secondary antibody and phalloidin cocktail: donkey anti-mouse-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), donkey anti-rabbit-Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500), and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:100) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.6 Wash sample in PBST on a rocker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with solution changed every 2 hours)
1.7 Post-fixation in 4% PFA in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.8 Wash sample in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

3  Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Diethyl Ether (freshly opened). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution: Diphenyl Ether (DPE) with 0.5% (wt/vol) 2,2'-Thiodiethanol as antioxidant. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until sample is fully cleared, typically 12-24 hours)

1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2  Immunostaining (Post-Clearing)
2.1 Rehydration through graded methanol series: 100%, 80%, 50%, 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes each)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1) + Alexa Fluor 647, Podocin (NPHS2) + Alexa Fluor 555, Lectin (凝集素) + FITC]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional ability to render large, dense organs like the whole mouse kidney highly transparent while preserving endogenous and labeled fluorescence over long periods. It achieves high transparency through dehydration and lipid removal, crucial for a lipid-rich organ. The chosen labeling strategy directly targets the scientific goal: Nephrin and Podocin are core components of the slit diaphragm, allowing for dual-channel assessment of its continuity and potential local缺失. Lectin (e.g., Lotus Tetragonolobus Lectin, LTL) labels proximal tubules and provides essential anatomical context for identifying glomerular regions and distribution within the cortex. Alexa Fluor dyes offer bright, photostable signals compatible with uDISCO's solvent-based clearing.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Sample Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Wash fixed kidney sample in PBS with 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 6 hours with gentle agitation.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Incubation in blocking solution (5% normal donkey serum, 1% BSA, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: Chicken anti-Nephrin (1:200), Rabbit anti-Podocin (1:200), and FITC-conjugated Lotus Tetragonolobus Lectin (LTL, 1:100) in antibody dilution buffer (1% BSA, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours with gentle agitation.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.4 Wash sample in PBST, changing solution every 12 hours, for a total of 48 hours.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.5 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: Donkey anti-Chicken IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in antibody dilution buffer for 72 hours with gentle agitation.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.6 Wash sample in PBST, changing solution every 12 hours, for a total of 48 hours.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with a graded methanol series in PBS: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol (vol/vol in H2O), 2 hours per step.(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours)
2.2 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol for 4 hours to complete dehydration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 66% Dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% Methanol (vol/vol) for 3 hours for initial delipidation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 100% DCM for 15 minutes to remove residual methanol and further delipidate.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

3  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) for refractive index matching. Refresh DBE once after 3 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Storage of cleared sample in fresh DBE in a light-tight vial until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1) + Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2) + Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous clearing method that preserves fluorescence of antibody conjugates (e.g., Alexa Fluor dyes) exceptionally well and is highly effective for whole-organ clearing of fixed tissues, including kidney. It provides homogeneous transparency for samples up to ~1 cm thick, which matches the mouse kidney dimensions. The use of two distinct Alexa Fluor channels allows simultaneous, high-resolution 3D mapping of Nephrin and Podocin with minimal spectral overlap. Lectin (IB4) labels vasculature/glomerular endothelium, providing anatomical context without interfering with the primary podocyte targets. DAPI labels nuclei for cellular registration. CUBIC’s gentle, non‑solvent‑based chemistry maintains protein epitopes and is compatible with subsequent RI‑matching for high‑resolution light‑sheet or confocal imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  **Delipidation & Decolorization**  
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC‑R1 solution (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% Quadrol, 15 wt% Triton X‑100 in distilled water). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days, with gentle shaking)  
1.2 Replacement with fresh CUBIC‑R1 solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days, with gentle shaking)  

2  **Wash & Antibody Labeling**  
2.1 Rinse with PBS‑T (0.1% Triton X‑100 in PBS) 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  
2.2 Blocking and permeabilization in PBS‑T containing 5% normal donkey serum and 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti‑Nephrin (1:200) + goat anti‑Podocin (1:200) + biotinylated IB4 lectin (1:100) in PBS‑T with 5% serum. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5–7 days, with gentle shaking)  
2.4 Wash with PBS‑T 6 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)  
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: donkey anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) + donkey anti‑goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) + streptavidin Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in PBS‑T with 5% serum. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5–7 days, with gentle shaking)  
2.6 Wash with PBS‑T 6 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)  
2.7 Nuclear staining with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.8 Final wash with PBS‑T 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

3  **Refractive Index Matching**  
3.1 Incubation with CUBIC‑R2 solution (50 wt% sucrose, 25 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2′,2″‑nitrilotriethanol in distilled water, RI ≈ 1.48). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 days, with gentle shaking)  
3.2 Optional further RI adjustment by adding 2,2′,2″‑nitrilotriethanol to CUBIC‑R2 until RI = 1.52–1.53. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

4  **Mounting & Imaging**  
4.1 Transfer sample to imaging chamber filled with final CUBIC‑R2 solution (RI matched to objective).  
4.2 Image using light‑sheet or confocal microscope with appropriate filter sets for Alexa Fluor 488, 555, 647 and DAPI.

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin (凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS (PolyEthylene Glycol (PEG)-Associated Solvent System) is selected for its ability to achieve high transparency in dense, lipid-rich organs like the kidney while preserving endogenous and antibody-induced fluorescence. It effectively removes pigments and lipids through a graded organic solvent series, leading to uniform clearing of both cortex and medulla. The method supports deep antibody penetration due to tissue porosity created by delipidation. The chosen labeling strategy directly targets the two key slit diaphragm proteins (Nephrin and Podocin) with spectrally distinct, bright, and photostable Alexa Fluor dyes. Lectin (e.g., Lotus Tetragonolobus Lectin, LTL) is included to outline proximal tubules and aid in glomerular identification and cortical/medullary demarcation, while DAPI provides nuclear counterstain. This combination enables specific, low-background dual labeling of the filtration barrier, essential for 3D glomerular identification, volume measurement, and structural integrity assessment.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tissue Preparation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Wash fixed kidney (4% PFA) in 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4, 3 times for 1 hour each on a shaker. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours total)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) sucrose in PBS for cryoprotection until tissue sinks. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12-24 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 30% (wt/vol) sucrose in PBS until tissue sinks. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12-24 hours)
1.4 Embed tissue in Optimal Cutting Temperature (OCT) compound, freeze on dry ice, and store at -80 ℃ for at least 2 hours. (Temperature: -80 ℃, Time: 2 hours minimum)
1.5 Section frozen tissue into 100-150 µm thick slices using a cryostat. Collect slices in PBS with 0.02% sodium azide.

2  Immunostaining and Labeling
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking: Incubation with 0.5% Triton X-100 and 5% normal donkey serum in PBS on a shaker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Primary antibody incubation: Incubation with a mixture of chicken anti-Nephrin (1:200), rabbit anti-Podocin (1:200), and biotinylated Lotus Tetragonolobus Lectin (LTL, 1:100) in PBS with 0.1% Triton X-100 and 3% normal donkey serum on a shaker. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.3 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) 3 times for 1 hour each on a shaker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)
2.4 Secondary antibody and streptavidin incubation: Incubation with a mixture of donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and streptavidin Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) in PBST with 3% normal donkey serum on a shaker. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.5 Wash: Incubation with PBST 3 times for 1 hour each on a shaker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)
2.6 Nuclear staining: Incubation with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.7 Final wash: Incubation with PBS 3 times for 30 minutes each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)

3  Dehydration and Delipidation
3.1 Dehydration: Incubation with a graded ethanol series: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 95%, 100%, 100% (vol/vol) ethanol in water, each step for 1 hour on a shaker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 hours total)
3.2 Delipidation and decolorization: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-Butanol (tB) for 12 hours on a shaker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.3 Incubation with a 1:1 (vol/vol) mixture of 100% tB and 100% Benzyl Ether (DBE) for 6 hours on a shaker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4  Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG) for refractive index matching and final clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, or until fully transparent)
4.2 For long-term storage and imaging, mount the cleared tissue in fresh 100% DBE within a sealed imaging chamber.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]

Since the scientific goal is to trace two distinct retinal projection branches using lipid-soluble tracers, DiI and DiD are ideal for anterograde/retrograde labeling of axons and terminals without requiring antibody staining. uDISCO’s dehydration and delipidation steps will efficiently clear lipid-rich neural tissues while retaining the DiI/DiD signal in axons and synaptic terminals.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1  Dehydration and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated twice)  
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeated twice)

2.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) containing 0.4% (wt/vol) vitamin E (α‑tocopherol) as antioxidant.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, until tissue is transparent)

The chosen lipophilic carbocyanine dyes (DiI and DiD) are ideal for anterograde/retrograde tracing of neuronal projections. They are applied to the retina to label distinct axonal populations, and their signal persists through the uDISCO clearing process, directly answering the question of spatial segregation/convergence in LGN and V1 without requiring immunostaining. A nuclear counterstain (e.g., DAPI) is omitted as per instructions, as the tracer signal is primary.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Tracer Application and Post-Fixation
1.1  Focal injection of 1-2 µL of 2.5% (vol/vol) DiI (in DMSO) into specific retinal quadrant(s) for one projection branch.(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)
1.2  Focal injection of 1-2 µL of 2.5% (vol/vol) DiD (in DMSO) into distinct retinal quadrant(s) for the other projection branch.(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)
1.3  Incubation of injected retina in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in PBS for 48 hours for tracer diffusion.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.4  Wash of all tissues (retina, LGN, V1) in PBS 3 times to remove excess PFA.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

2  Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1  Incubation in a graded methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
2.2  Incubation in fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3  Incubation in 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD, Lectin (凝集素, e.g., PNA for retinal layers), Hoechst]
**Justification:** FDISCO (Fast Free-of-Acrylamide SDS-based Tissue Clearing with Off-the-shelf Reagents) is selected for its excellent preservation of lipophilic dye signals (DiI/DiD), minimal tissue shrinkage, and compatibility with small, delicate tissues like retina, LGN, and V1. It uses a urea/SDS-based delipidation that is gentler than organic solvents, crucial for preserving the layered architecture of the retina. The protocol includes a critical dehydration and rehydration step that significantly reduces tissue autofluorescence (low background). The final refractive index matching with TDE is simple, reversible, and provides good optical clarity for 3D imaging. The chosen labeling strategy uses the pre-applied lipophilic tracers (DiI/DiD) and adds a lectin (e.g., Peanut Agglutinin - PNA) to counterstain and visualize retinal laminae, along with Hoechst for nuclear architecture, all compatible with FDISCO.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Dehydration and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) urea in 30% (vol/vol) glycerol / 0.1% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) urea in 40% (vol/vol) glycerol / 0.1% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) urea in 50% (vol/vol) glycerol / 0.1% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) urea in 60% (vol/vol) glycerol / 0.1% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) urea in 80% (vol/vol) glycerol / 0.1% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) urea in 100% (vol/vol) glycerol. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Incubation with FDISCO delipidation solution: 8% (wt/vol) SDS, 20% (wt/vol) urea, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in 1x PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48-72 hours, with gentle shaking. Monitor clearing progress.)

2  Washing and Rehydration (Critical for background reduction)
2.1 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) three times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) glycerol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) glycerol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 15% (vol/vol) glycerol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST three times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

3  Optional Immuno/Histo-labeling (For Lectin and Hoechst)
3.1 Blocking and permeabilization in blocking buffer: 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Fluorescently-conjugated Lectin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488-PNA, 5-10 µg/mL) and Hoechst 33342 (1:1000 dilution) in antibody dilution buffer (1% BSA, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48-72 hours, gentle shaking)
3.3 Wash with PBST five times over 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1-2 hours per wash)

4  Refractive Index Matching and Storage
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) 2,2'-Thiodiethanol (TDE) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) TDE in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) TDE in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) TDE in PBS (RI ~1.46). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 97% (vol/vol) TDE in ddH2O (RI ~1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours for equilibration, then store at 4 ℃ in the dark for imaging)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate), Myosin VIIa (primary antibody, Alexa Fluor 647 conjugate), DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its exceptional ability to render hard, mineralized tissues (like the bony cochlea) transparent while preserving endogenous fluorescence and antibody epitopes. It achieves high transparency and a high refractive index (RI ~1.56), which is crucial for imaging dense, light-scattering bone. The labeling strategy directly addresses the scientific goals: Phalloidin-AF488 provides high-fidelity, direct labeling of F-actin in stereocilia bundles and cuticular plates. Myosin VIIa is a definitive molecular marker for hair cells (both inner and outer), allowing for unambiguous cell identity and counting. DAPI stains nuclei to assess cellularity and architecture. This combination enables clear 3D visualization of hair cell arrangement, integrity, and actin cytoskeleton.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Sample Preparation and Decalcification
1.1 Post-fixation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (PB).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with 0.1 M PB (3 x 1 hour).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.3 Decalcification with 10% ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA, pH 7.4) in 0.1 M PB.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days, with solution changed daily)
1.4 Wash with 0.1 M PB (3 x 1 hour).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.5 Permeabilization and blocking with incubation solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% normal goat serum, 1% bovine serum albumin in 0.1 M PB).(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

2  Immunofluorescence and F-actin Labeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: rabbit anti-Myosin VIIa (1:500) and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100) in antibody dilution buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 5% normal goat serum, 1% BSA in 0.1 M PB).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.2 Wash with 0.1 M PB containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (5 x 2 hours).(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours)
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody: goat anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 days)
2.4 Wash with 0.1 M PB containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (5 x 2 hours).(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours)

3  Dehydration and Lipid Removal
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in deionized water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.5 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, 2 times)

4  uDISCO Clearing and RI Matching
4.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI ~1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, until tissue is fully transparent)
4.2 Storage and imaging in fresh dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488, Myosin VIIa-Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically designed for clearing calcified tissues (e.g., bone, teeth) and is ideal for the intact, bony mouse cochlea. It preserves fluorescence well, is compatible with immunolabeling, and achieves high transparency while maintaining structural integrity. Phalloidin directly labels F-actin in stereocilia bundles, Myosin VIIa is a definitive marker for hair cell identity, and DAPI labels nuclei to visualize cell bodies and cochlear architecture. This combination allows simultaneous visualization of hair cell bodies, stereocilia bundles, and bony structures across cochlear turns.

**Protocol Steps:**
1  Decalcification and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) in PBS with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) three times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)
1.3 Incubation with PBST containing 20% (vol/vol) DMSO and 2.3% (wt/vol) glycine for permeabilization and quenching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

2  Immunolabeling and F-actin Staining
2.1 Blocking with PBST containing 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum and 6% (wt/vol) bovine serum albumin. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody against Myosin VIIa (rabbit polyclonal, 1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST six times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (goat anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Wash with PBST six times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)
2.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBST for nuclear staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Final wash with PBST three times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

3  Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Dehydration in a graded methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in water, each step for 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 20 hours total)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for final dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.3 Incubation with BoneClear solution (88% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate, RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

4  Refractive Index Matching and Mounting
4.1 Transfer the cleared cochlea into fresh BoneClear solution for storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)
4.2 Mount the sample in a chamber filled with BoneClear solution for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.
